text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text_en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Mahakasika ny toe-bola maneran-tany, i Zapatero dia nanohy nilaza fa ny “rafitra ara-bola dia ao anatin’ny toe-karena, izay ampahany lehibe.
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Miatrika krizy ara-bola mandritry ny herintaona isika, izay tena nahery vaika nandritry ny roa volana lasa izay, ary mieritreritra aho fa manomboka miarina izao ny tsena ara-barotra.”
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Nanambara ny Naked News tamin’ny herinandro lasa fa hampitombo ny iraka amin’ny teny iraisam-pirenena ka hisy fampitam-baovao telo hiforona indray .
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Efa manao tatitra amin’ny teny anglisy sy japoney ilay fikambanana iraisam-pirenena ary hanomboka ny fandaharana amin’ny teny espaniola, italiana sy kôreana, ho an’ny fahitalavitra, tranonkala sy finday.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Soa ihany fa tsy naninona aho, fa nahita zavatra mahatsiravina aho, sady ny olona niezaka namaky fitaratra mba hitsoahana.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Nikapoka ny fitaratra tamin’ny seza ny olona, nefa tsy nety vaky ny varavarakely.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: “Vaky ihany ny iray tamin’ireo fitaratra ny farany, ary nanomboka nivoaka tamin’ny varavarankely izy ireo”, hoy ilay nieren-doza Franciszek Kowal.
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Mandefa hazavana sy hafanana ny kintana noho ny angovo miforona rehefa mikambana (na mitambatra) ny ataomana hidrozena ka manamboatra singa mavesatra kokoa.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Miasa amin’ny famoronana motera izay afaka manao hery amin’iny fomba iny ny siatifika.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Inty anefa dia olana tena sarotra vahana ary hiandry taona maro isika vao hahita reaktera nokleary vita ka azo ampiasaina.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Mitsingevana eo ambonin’ny rano ilay fanjaitra noho ny fihenjanana ambonin'ny ranoka.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Misy ny tension de surface satria ny molekiolan’ny rano ety ivelany dia mifampisintona mafy kokoa noho izy ireo sy ny molekiolan’ny rivotra eo amboniny.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Mamokatra ohatra ny hoditra tsy hita maso eny ambony rano ny maolekiolan’ny rano ka izany no mahatonga ny zavatra sasany toy ilay fanjaitra hitsingevana eny ambony rano.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Misy sisiny roa ny lelan’ilay kiraro vaovao fentina mandeha amin’ny ranomandry ary misy lavaka roa eo anelanelany. Ireo lavaka roa ireo no mahatonga azy afaka mifikitra tsara anaty lanezy na dia rehefa mitongilana aza.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Satria somary miolaka ny vodin'ilay lelany, rehefa mihorirana mankany amin’ny lafiny iray na ny ilany ilay lelany dia miolaka koa ny morony izay mifampikasoka amin’ny ranomandry.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Nahatonga ny mpandeha fikorisana hiodina izany. Raha makany amin’ny ankavanana ny fikorisana, dia mivily miankavanana ny mpitondra azy, raha makany amin’ny ankavia ny fikorisana, dia makany amin’ny ankavia ny mpitondra azy.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Mba hiverenana amin’ny haavon’ny herijikan’izy ireo teo aloha, dia mila manala ny herijika mihoatra izay azony tamin’ny hazavana izy ireo.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Ataon’izy ireo izany amin’ny fandefasana ampahana hazavana kely izay antsoina hoe "voan-kazavana.”
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Ny siantifika dia miantso ity zotra ity hoe “émission stimulée de radiation” satria ny ataoma dia tairin'ny hazavana mamiratra, izay miteraka voan-kazavana, ary ny hazavana dia karazana taratra.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Ny sary manaraka dia maneho ny atôma mamoaka voan-kazavana. Mazava ho azy, amin’ny tena izy ny voan-kazavana dia bitika lavitra noho izay eo amin’ny sary.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Ny voankazavana dia mbola kely noho ny zavatra mamorona ny ataoma !
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Rehefa avy niasa nandritra ny adiny zato ilay tariby tao amin’ilay takamoa dia mirehitra ny farany ary tsy mandeha intsony ilay takamoa.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Nila nosoloina araka izany ny takamoa. Ilaina ny mitandrina rehefa manolo ny takamoa.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Voalohany aloha dia mila mipika ny famonoana an’ilay jiro na tsoahina ny kabla.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Ny antony dia satria ny herinaratra mandalo amin’ilay fitsatohana misy ny faritra metalikan’ny takamoa dia mety hahatonga famaizana mafy avy amin’ny herinaritra raha toa ka voakasikao ny faritra anatin’ilay fitsatohana na ilay fanambany metalikan’ilay takamoa raha mbola misy ampahany kely tavela ao anatin’ilay fitsatohana.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Ny fo no taova lehibe indrindra amin’ny rafi-pitaterana, izy no mipaompy ny rà.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Miala avy ao amin’ny fo ny rà amin’ny alalan’ny fantsona antsoina hoe mpanelirà ary miverina ao amin’ny fo amin’ny alalan’ny fantsona antsoina hoe mpamerindrà. Ny fantsona kely indrindra dia antsoina hoe lalandrà madinika.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Ny nifin’ny triceratops dia mety afaka nikepoka tsy ny ravina ihany fa ny sampana sy ny fototra ihany koa.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Heverin’ny ny siantifika sasany fa nihinana cycadale, izay karazana zava-maniry hita betsaka tamin’ny kretasea, ny triseratopsa.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Ireo zavamaniry ireo dia hoatran’ny rofia kely misy ravina maranitra, matsilo hoatran’nysatroboninahitra.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Afaka nampiasa ilay vavany matanjaka ny Triceratops mba hanongotana ny ravinkazo mialoha ny hihinanana ny vatan-kazo.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Ny siantifika hafa dia nandroso fa misy poizina be ireo zavamaniry ireo ka tsy azo inoana loatra hoe nisy dinôzôro nihinana, na dia amin’izao fotoana aza dia misy ny paresseux sy biby hafa toy ny boloky (taranaky ny dinôzôro) afaka mihinana ravina na voankazo misy poizina.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Ahoana ny fisintonan’i Io ahy? Raha mijoro eo aminy Io ianao dia milanja latsaky ny tokony ho lanjanao eto an-tany ianao.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Ny olona izay milanja 200 pounds (90 kg) eo amin’ny Tany dia milanja eo amin’ny 36 pounds (16kg) eo amin’ny Io. Izany hoe, mazava ho azy fa tsy misarika mafy anao ny sinton’ny tany.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Tsy manana fonony afaka itsanganana toy ny tany ny Masoandro. Ny masoandro iray manontolo dia gazy, afo, ary ranon-javatra madity.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Lasa mihamanify ny entona arakaraka ny analaviranao ny afovoan’ny Masoandro.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Ny faritra ivelany izay hitantsika rehefa mijery ny Masoandro no antsoina hoe photosphère, izay midika hoe “baolin’ny hazavana”.
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Telo arivo taona tatỳ aoriana, tamin’ny 1610, dia nampiasa teleskaopy i Galileo Galilei, astronoma italianina, mba hahitany fa misy laharam-piovana ohatra ny volana koa i Venus.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Misy ny laharam-piovana satria ny ilan’i Venus ihany (na ny volana) manatrika ny masoandro no mazava. Ny laharam-piovan’i Venus dia manamafy ny tsangan-kevitr’i Kopernika fa mihodina manodidina ny masoandro ny planeta.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Avy eo, taona vitsivitsy taty aorian’izany, tamin’ny taona 1639 dia nisy mpikaroka momba ny kintana atao hoe Jeremiah Horrocks nandinika ny fizotran’i Venus.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Niaina fotoam-pilaminana lava i Angletera taorian’ny fakana indray an’i Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Tamin’ny 991, sambany indray ny Etherled no nifanandrina tamin’ny Viking taorian’ny niadiany tamin’ny Guthrum an-jatony talohan’izay.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Olaf Trygvasson no nitarika ny andian-tsambo, Norvezianina iray nanam-paniriana ny hanaisotra ny fireneny eo ambany ziogan’ny Danois .
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Taorian’ny fihemoran'ny tafika tany am-boalohany dia vitan'i Ethelred ny nifanaraka tamin'i Olaf, izay niverina tany Norvezy mba haka indray ny fiandrianany izay tsy tena nahomby.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul ihany no abidia niniana noforonina ho fampiasan’ny olona isan’andro. Io abidia io dia noforonina tamin’ny taona 1444 tamin’ny fanjakan’ny mpanjaka Sejong (1418-1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: I King Sejong no mpanjaka faha efatra tao amin’ny fanjakana Joseon ary anisan’ny omem-boninahitra indrindra.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Tamin’ny voalohany dia nantsoiny hoe Hunmin Jeongeum ny abidý Hangeul, izay midika hoe “ilay feo marina ho fampianarana ny vahoaka”.
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Betsaka ny teoria mikasika ny niforonan’ny Sanskrit. Iray amin’ireny ny fifindran’ny Aryan monina avy any andrefana nankany India izay nitondra ny fiteniny niaraka taminy.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Ny Sanskrita dia teny fahiny ary azo oharina amin’ny teny Latina izay nampiasaina tany Eoropa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Nosoratana tamin’ny teny Sanskrit ny boky antitra indrindra fantatra maneran-tany. Rehefa avy natambatra ny Upanishads, dia nanjavona fotsiny ny Sanskrit noho ny ambaratongam-pahefana.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskrit dia fiteny mananosarotra sy manankarena, nampiasaina ho loharanon’ireo fiteny indiana maoderina, ohatran’ny hoe ny Latina dia loharanon’ireo fiteny Eoropeana maro toy ny Frantsay sy Espanola.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Mivonona ny hananika ny nosin’i Bretagne i Alemana satria tapitra ny ady izay nitranga tany Frantsa.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Nantsoin’i Alemainina tamin’ny anarana miafina hoe “Hetsika Sealion” ny fanafihana. Ny ankamaroan’ny fitaovampiadiana mavesatry ny Anglisy sy ny vatsiny dia very rehefa nivoaka an’i Dunkirk, ka dia azo lazaina ho nalemy ny tafika.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Fa ny Tafika andranomasin’ny Mpanjaka dia mbola matanjaka lavitra noho ny Tafika andranomasin’ny alemana (“Kriegsmarine”) ary afaka namotika izay mety ho andian-tsambo nalefa hanafika tao amin’ny Lakandranon’ny Anglisy.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Kanefa, vitsy ny sambo miaramila ny Mpanjaka nipetraka akaiky ny fanafihana noho’ny fahatahoran’ireo amiraly fa ho rendriky ny fanafihana an-abakabaky ny Jermana.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Ndao atomboka amin’ny fanazavana momba ny paikadin’i Italia. Italia dia ilay “zandry kelin”’i Alemaina sy Japana tamin’ny ankapobeny.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Narefo kokoa ny tafika sy tafika an-tsambo nananany na dia vao nanamboatra sambo aza izy ireo taloha kelin’ny niantombohan’ny ady.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Ny tanjon’I Italia amin’ny ankapobeny dia ireo firenena Afrikanina. Hisamborana ireo firenena ireo, dia mila fandefasana tafika izy, mba hahafahan’ireo tafika mandeha amin’ny ranomasina Mediterranea ka mananika an’i Afrika.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Noho izany dia nila namotika ny toby sy ny sambo britanika izay hita tany Ejipta izy ireo. Ankoatran’ireo dia tsy tokony ho nanao zavatra hafa ireo sambo mpiadin’i Italia.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: I Japana indray izao. I Japana dia firenena nosy tahaka an’I Grande Bretagne.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Ny sambo mpisitrika dia sambo namboarina handeha anaty rano, ary hijanona ao mandritra ny fotoana maharitra.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Ny sambondrano dia nampiasana tamin’ny Ady Lehibe voalohany sy ny Ady Lehibe Faharoa. Tamin’izany dia niadana be izy ireny no sady voafetra ny fahafahany mitifitra.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Tany am-piandohan’ny ady dia teny ambony ranomasina no tena lalany, fa noho ny nanomboka nivoatra ny radara no sady niha marina tsara dia tsy maintsy nandeha tao ambanin’ny rano ny sambo mpisitrika mba tsy ho hita.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: U-Boats no niantsoana ireo sambo mpisitrika alemana. Ry zareo Alemana dia tena nahay nitondra sy nampiasa ireo sambo mpisitrika ireo.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Noho ny fahombiazan’izy ireo tamin’ny sambo mpisitrika dia heverina fa tsy manana betsaka amin’izy ireny ireo Alemana taorian’ny ady.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Eny! Ny mpanjaka Tutankhamun, izay antsoina matetika hoe “Mpanjaka Tut” na “Mpanjaka kely”, no anisan’ny mpanjaka ejypsianina malaza indrindra amin’izao androntsika izao.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Mahaliana, izy dia tsy noheverina ho manan-danja tamin’ny fotoana fahiny ary tsy voarakitra tao amin’ny lisitr’ireo mpanjaka fahiny indrindra.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Nefa, ny fahitana ny fasany tamin’ny taona 1922 dia nahatonga azy ho olo-malaza. Raha toa ka voaroba ny ankamaroan’ny fasana, ity iray ity kosa dia tsy mba voakorontana mihitsy.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Ny ankamaroan’ny zavatra nalevina niaraka tamin’i Tutankhamun dia voaaro tsara, ao anatin’izay ny asa-tànana aman’arivony vita tamin’ny vy sy ny vato sarobidy.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Ny famoronana ny kodiarana misy talantalana dia nahatonga ny sarety asyrianina ho maivana, haingana sy voaomana kokoa mba hisongona ireo miaramila sy sarety hafa.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Ny zana-tsipika avy amin’ny tsipika mahafaty dia tafiditra amin’ny akanjo fiarovan’ny miaramila mifanatrika. Tamin’ny taona 1000 alohan’ny Jesoa Kristy, nantsangan’ny Asyriana ny Kavaliria voalohany.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Ny kavaleria dia tafika mitaingin-tsoavaly rehefa miady. Mbola tsy nisy ny lasely, ka niady ambonin’ny soavaly tsy misy lasely ny kavaleria Asyriana.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Mahafantatra politisianina, siantifika, ary mpanao zava-kanto grika be dia be isika. Ny olona fanta-daza indrindra amin’io kolontsaina io angamba dia i Homer, ilay mpanao tononkalo jamba malaza be, izay nanoratra sanganasa roa tamin’ny literatiora grika : ireo tononkalon’ny Iliad sy Odyssey.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocles sy Aristophances dia mbola mpanoratra tantara an-tsehatra malaza ary ny tantara an-tsehany dia heverina ho anisan’ireo asa lehibe indrindra eo amin’ny tontolon’ny haisoratra.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Grika iray hafa malaza ny matematisianina Pythagore, fantatra manokana noho ny teôrema momba ny fifandraisan’ny zoron'ny telozoro mahitsizoro.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Ireo dia tombana miovaova ahitana hoe firy ny olona miteny Hindi. Heverina ho eo anelan’ireo fiteny faharoa sy fahefatra izay be mpiresaka indrindra maneran-tany izany.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Ny isan’ny teratany mpampiasa ny teny reny dia miankina amin’ny hoe isaina ve ireo tenim-paritra mifanakaiky aminy.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Notombanana ho 340 tapitrisa ka hatramin’ny 500 tapitrisa no miteny, ary hatramin’ny 800 tapitrisa no olona mety hahazo ilay fiteny.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Ny teny Hindi sy Urdu dia misy itovizany amin’ny voambolana fa samy hafa kosa ny fanoratra azy; rehefa miresaka amin’ny andavanandro dia matetika mifankahazo ny olona miteny ireo teny roa ireo.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Manodidina ny taon-jato faha15, dia teo ambanin’ny tsindry ara-kolotoraly lehibe nataon’i Alemana i Estonia avaratra.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Naniry ny hitondra an’Andriamanitra akaiky kokoa an’ireo vahoaka teratany ny moanina Alemà sasany , ka namorona ny fiteny ara-bakiteny Estonianina izy ireo.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Niainga tamin’ny alfabeta alemana izany ary nampiana terehin-tsoratra iray “Õ/õ”.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Rehefa nandeha ny fotoana dia maro ireo teny nindramina tamin’ny Alemana izay nitambatra. Io no niantombohan’ny fahazavantsaina.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Ara-pomba dia mandalo fiofanana ara-miaramila ny mpandova ny seza fiandrianana aorian’ny fahavitany ny fianarana an-tsekoly.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Na izany aza, nankany amin’ny oniversiten’ny Trinity College, Cambridge I Charles izay nianarany Antropolojia sy Arkeolojia, ary Tantara nony taty aoriana, ka nahazoany naoty 2:2 (naoty sokajy faharoa ambany kokoa)
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: I Charles no voalohany nomena diplaoma tamin’ny fianakavian’ny mpanjakan’i Grande Bretagne.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: I Torkia eoropeanina (Thrace atsinanana na Romelia ao amin’ny saikinosy lehibe Balkan) dia mandrafitra ny 3 isan-jaton’ny firenena.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Ny faritanin’i Tiorkia dia mihoatra ny 1.600 kilaometatra (1.000 mi) ny halavany ary 800 km (500 mi) ny sakany, ary manana endrika mitovitovy amin’ny mahitsizoro.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Manana velarana 783.562 km² (300.948 mi²) ny faritr’i Tiorkia, anatin'izany ireo farihy izay misy ao aminy, izay ny 755.688 km² (291.773 mi²) amin’ireo dia any Azia atsimo andrefana fa ny 23.764 km² (9.174 mi²) kosa dia ao Eoropa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Ny faritr’i Torkia no firenena fa 37 lehibe indrindra eto an-tany, ary manakaiky ny haben’ny fitambaran’i Frantsa sy ny Fanjakana Britanika.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Misy ranomasina telo manodidina an’i Tiorkia: ny Ranomasina Égée ny ao andrefana, ny Ranomasina Mainty no ao avaratra ary ny Ranomasina Mediteranea no ao atsimo.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Lava ny tantaran'i Luxembourg, fa tamin’ny 1839 no nahazoany ny fahaleovantenany.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Ny ampahan’i Belzika amin’izao fotoana izao, izay dia ampahan’i Luxembourg taloha fa lasa Belza taorian’ny revolusiona belza taorian’ny taona 1830.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Niezaka n hijanona ho firenena tsy miandany amin’iza n’iza hatrany i Luxembourg fa nefa nanjakain’ny Alemana izy nandritra ny ady lehibe voalohany sy ny ady lehibe faharoa.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Tamin’ny 1957 i Luxembourg no lasa mpikambana mpanorina ny fikambanana izay fantatra ankehitriny amin'ny anarana hoe Vondrona Eoropeanina.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Ny Drukgyal Dzon dia lapa simba sy mônastera bodista tao amin’ny faritra ambony tao amin’ny distrikan’i Paro (tao amin’ny tanànan’i Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Voalaza fa tamin’ny taona 1649 dia namorona ny manda fiarovana ho fahatsiarovana ny fandreseny ireo tafika Tibetana-Mongolianina i Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Tamin’ny 1951, vitsy sisa ny vakoka tavela tao Drukgyal Dzong noho ny afo, anisan’izany ny sarin’i Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Taorian’ny firehetana izay nitranga dia voatahiry sy voaaro ilay manda, ary mbola mijanona ho isan’ny toerana mahasarika ny mpitsidika maro any Bhoutan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Nandritra ny taonjato faha 18, I Kambodza dia tery tao anelanelana mpifanolobodirindrina roa matanjaka, Tailandy sy Vietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Nanafika an’i Kambodia imbetsaka ny Thais tamin’ny taon-jato faha18 ary tamin’ny 1772 dia namotika an’i Phnom Phen izy ireo.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Tamin’ny taona faran’ny taonjato faha 18 dia nanafika an’i Kambodza ihany koa ireo Vietnamiana.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Ny valo ambin’ny folo isan-jaton'ny Venezoelianina dia tsy an’asa, ary ny ankamaroan'ireo izay miasa dia eo amin'ny sehatra tsy ara-dalàna.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Miasa amin’ny famatsiana ny androantokon’ny Venezoeliana, ary efa ho ny ampahefany no miasa amin’ny indostria ary ny ampahadiminy no mamboly.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Indostria manana ny lanjany ho an’ny Venezueliana ny menaka, ny firenena ny manondrana na dia hoe iray isan-jato ihany no miasa amin’ny indostria.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Tany am-piandohan'ny fahaleovantenan’ny firenena, ny fandinihana ireo Zaridaina Botanikan'i Singapaoro dia nanampy namadika ny nosy ho Tanànan-jaridaina traopikaly.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Tamin’ny taona 1981 dia Vanda Miss Joaquim, izay orkide safiotra, no voasafidy ho vonikazo nasionalin’ny firenena.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Isan-taona, manodidina ny volana Oktobra, biby mihinana ahitra eo amin’ny 1,5 tapitrisa eo no mankany any amin’ireo tany lemaka any atsimo, miampita ny onin’I Mara, avy eny amin’ny havoana avaratra ho an’ny orana.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Ary niverina avy any avaratra nakany andrefana avy eo, ary niampita ny renirano Mara indray avy eo, tao aorian’ny orana manodidina ny volana Aprily.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Ao amin’ny faritry ny Serengeti no misy ny Valan-java-boaary Nasionalin’i Serengeti, ny vala tahirin’i Ngorongoro ary ny saha fihazan’i Maswa any Tanzania sy ny saha Tahiry Nasionalin’i Maasai Mara any Kenia.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Raha hianatra hamorona serasera mifandray dia mila havanana amin’ny fanao manokana oe an-toerana sy ny fanao ifanarahana amin’ny rehetra, ary koa fitaovana fehezina amin’ireny kilasy mifandray ireny (fanaovana storyboard, fanamboarana feo sy horonan-tsary, fanaovana tantara, sns.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Ny fandrafetana mampifandray dia mitaky ny famerenanao mandinika ny fiheveranao momba ny famokarana haino aman-jery sy ny fianaranao misaina amin’ny fomba mivelatra.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Ny fandrafetana mampifandray dia mitaky ny fifandraisan'ireo singa mandrafitra ny tetikasa iray, fa ihany koa ny mba hisiany dikany amin'ny maha singa mahaleotena azy.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Ny indro kely amin’ny fitaratra manangeza dia ny fahasarotan’ny ampovoany sy ny isan’ny fitaratra ilaina mba ahazoana ny halavitry ny ampofoavy dia lehibe noho ny fitaratra voalohany.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Efa tsy dia olana be intsony izany ankehitriny satria ireo mpamokatra vera dia efa mahavita mamokatra vera avo lenta kokoa.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Namela ny vera fanalehibiazana hamokatra sary tsara kalitao azo ampitahaina amin’ireo vitan’ny vera manana halavanà fifantohana tsy miova izany.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Lafiratsin’ny fampiasana ny masolavitry ny fakantsary ihany koa dia ny fara-fisokafany (ny hafainganany) izay ambany amin’ny ankapobeny.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Mahatonga ny vera manalehibe mora vidy ho sarotra ampiasaina amin’ny toerana manana hazavana ambany izany rehefa tsy misy jiro fanampiny.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Ny olana iray lehibe matetika rehefa miezaka mamadika horonantsary ho DVD dia ny Surbalayage.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Ny ankamaroan’ny fahitalavitra dia natao mba ho tian’ny mpijery amin’ny ankapobeny.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Izany no antony mahatonga an’izay hitanao amin’ny fahitalavitra tapaka ny ambony, ambany ary ny sisiny.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Izany dia natao mba hahazoana antoka fa mameno ny efijery manontolo ilay sary. Izay no atao hoe overscan.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Indrisy moa izany fa rehefa manamboatra DVD ianao dia tsy maintsy ho voatapaka koa ny sisiny, ary raha nisy soratra lasa ambany loatra dia tsy maintsy ho tapaka.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Ny rova nentim-paharazana fahagola dia efa ela no nanome aingampanahy ny eritreritra, maneho ny saritsarin’ireo ady ambony soavaly, ny fanasambe sy ny fomba fitondran-tenan'ny chevaliers artorianina.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Na dia mitsangana eo afovoan’ny zavatra rava sisa tavela efa an’arivo taonany aza dia mbola mora ny maka sary an-tsaina ny feo sy ny fofon'ady efa lasa efa ela, ny maheno ny kitron-tsoavaly mikapokapoka amin’ny lalana mirary vato sy maheno ny fofon'ny tahotra miakatra avy ao anatin’ireo lavaka misy ny voafonja.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Fa ny fanofinofisantsika ve mifototra amin’ny tena misy? Fa maninona anefa no naorina ny rova? Ahoana ny fomba nanamboarana sy naminavinana azy ireny?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Mifanaraka indrindra amin’ny vanim-potoana tamin’izany, trano nohamafisina kokoa ny Rovan’ny Kirby Muxloe fa tsy tena rova.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Tsy ho nahatohitra fanafihana maty paika ireo varavarankeliny fitaratra sy ireo rindriny manify.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Tany amin’ny taona 1480 tany, rehefa nanomboka nanorina azy ny Lord Hasting, dia azo lazaina ho nilamina ilay firenena ka tsy dia nila fiarovana firy afatsy tamin’ny andiana mpanafika kely madinidinika.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Ny fifandanjan-kery dia rafitra iray izay nikatsahan'ny firenena eoropeanina ny hitazonana ny fiandrianan’ny fanjakana eoropeanina rehetra.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Ny hevitra napetraka dia ny hoe tsy maintsy nitady ny hanakanana ny firenena iray tsy hatanjaka ny firenena eoropeanina rehetra, ka nanova matetika ny fifanarahany ireo governemanta mba handanjalanjana azy tsara.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Ny Adin’ny Fifandimbiasana Espaniôla no ady voalohany izay nifototra tamin’ny fifandanjan-kery.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Nanamarika fiovana lehibe ity, satria tsy afaka ampiasa ny fivavahana hananganana ady intsony ny fahefana Eurôpeanina. Noho izany, ny Ady Telopolo Taona no ady farany nolazaina fa ady masina.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Ny tempolin’i Artemisy tao Efesosy dia simba ny 21 Jolay 356 tal. J.K. tao anatina fandoroana niniana nataon’i Erostraty.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Raha ny tantara no jerena dia ny hany nanentana azy dia ny filany voninahitra fatratra. Ireo efesianina, izay tohina dia tohina, dia nanambara fa ny anaran’i Herostratus dia tsy hosoratana mandrakizay.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Ilay mpahay tantara Grika Strado dia nanamarika ny anarana taty aoriana, izay fantatsika ankehitriny. Ny tempoly dia simba ny alin’ny nahaterahan’ny Aleksandra Le Grand.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexander, amin’ny maha-mpanjaka azy, dia nanolo-tena handoa ny vola hanarenana ny tempoly, saingy nolavina izany fanomezany izany. Taty aoriana, rehefa maty i Alexander, dia narenina ilay tempoly tamin’ny taona 323 talohan’ i Jesosy Kristy.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Ataovy azo antoka fa milamina tsara ny tanana eo am-panoratana ny naoty araka ny tokony ho izy - ary koa miezaha tsy dia manao fihetsika be amin’ny ratsan-tananao.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Amin’ity fomba ity dia mba tsy ho reraka be ny tenanao. Tadidio fa tsy ilaina ny manindry ny bokotra mafy mba hahazoana feo mafy toy ny amin’ny piano.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Amin’ny angorodao, ahazoana feo mafy tsara, dia tsindrina mafimafy ary haingana kokoa ny lakolosy.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Ny fivavahana mifono zava-miafina dia ny fikatsahana ny firaisana amin’ny, fitoviana amin’ny, na fahatongavan-tsaina amin’ny zava-misy avo indrindra, andriamanitra, fahamarinana ara-panahy, na Andriamanitra.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Ny mpino dia mitady fahatsapana mivantana, tsindrimandry, na koa endrikendrikin’ny fisian’Andriamanitra / ny maha-andriamanitra na ny andriamanitra.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Manaraka fomba fiaina manokana ny mpanaraka, na fahazarana izay mikendry mba hikajy izany zavatra iainana izany.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Ny mysticisme dia azo avahana amin’ny karazana finoana sy fanompoam-pivavahana hafa noho izy manamafy ny fahatsapanao mivantana fahatsiarovantena tsy manampaharoa, indrindra ireo izay manana toetra tia fihavanana, marani-tsaina, sambatra, na ireo dibo-kafaliana aza.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Fivavahana avy any amin’ny kontinantan’i Azia ny Sikhism. Avy tao amin’ny faritr’i Punjab no niantombohany tamin’ny taonjato faha-15, ary fivavahana nisaraka tamin’ny fombafomba Hindou izy io.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Mandray ny finoany ho fivavahana samy hafa amin’ny Hindoisma ny Sikhs na dia eken’izy ireo aza ny fototra sy fombafomba Hindoa ao aminy.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Gurmat no iantsoan’ny Sikhs ny fivavahany, izay midika hoe “fomban’ny mpitarika” amin’ny teny Punjabi. Ny mpitarika dia manana ny toerana lehibe amin’ny fivavahana Indiana rehetra saingy amin’ny Sikhisma dia vao may manana toerana lehiba amin’ny fototry ny finoana Sikh.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Naorin'ny Gourou Nanak tamin’ny taonjato faha 15 (1469-1539) ilay fivavahana. Taorian’izay dia nisy gourous sivy hafa nifandimby.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Kanefa, tamin’ny volana jona taona 1956 dia nozahana toetra ireo fampanantenan’i Krushchev rehefa nivadika ho hetsika fanoherana tanteraka ny kaomonisma ireo fihetsiketsehana tany Polonina izay nanoheran’ireo mpiasa ny tsy fisian’ny sakafo sy ny fidinan’ny karama.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Na dia nandefa fiara mifono vy aza i Krushchev tamin'ny farany hamerenana ny filaminana, dia nanaiky ireo fangatahana ara-toekarena sasany ihany izy ary nanaiky hanendry an’i Wladyslaw Gomulka, izay mamim-bahoaka, ho praiministra vaovao.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Ny Sivilizasiôn’ny Lohasahan'ny Indoa dia sivilizasiôn’ny Andron'ny Alimo any amin’ny faritra avaratra andrefan’I Inde izay mahafaoka an’I Pakistana amin’izao fotoana sy ny faritra sasany any avaratra andrefan’I Inde ary any avaratra atsinanan’I Afganistana.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Ilay sivilizasiôna dia nivelatra tao amin’ny deboka andalovan’ny renirano Indus izay toerana niavian’ny anarany.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Manombatombana ny mpikaroka sasany hoe satria nisy sivilizasiona tany amin’ilay Renirano Sarasvati, izay efa ritra izao, ka tokony hantsoina hoe Indus Sarasvati ny fandrosoana nisy tany, nefa ny sasany miantso azy hoe Sivilizasiona Harappan avy amin’ny hoe Harappa. Tany amin’ny 1920 tany ho any no nisy olona nikaroka voalohany tany.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Ny toetoetra ara-miaramilan’ny Fanjakana Romana dia nanampy ny fivoaran’ ny fitsaboana.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Nanomboka nampidirin’ny Amperora Augustus ny dokotera ary nanangana ny Ekipa Mpitsabo Rômanina voalohany mihitsy aza mba hiasa aorian’ny loza vokatry ny ady.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Nahalala fampatoriana maro ny mpandidy, anisan’izany ny môrfinina avy amin’ny voana pavot sy ny skôpôlaminina avy amin’ny voana jusquiame noire.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Izy ireo dia lasa matihanina amin’ny fanapahana mba hanavotana marary amin’ny fery mandoaka ary amin’ny fangejana sy fanerena ny lalan-drà lehibe ihany koa mba hanakanana ny fikorian’ny rà.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Nandritra ny taonjato maromaro, ny fanjakana Romana dia nanisy fandrosoana lehibe teo amin’ny sehatry ny fitsaboana ary namorona ny ankamaroan’ny zavatra haintsika amin’izao fotoana izao.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Ny origami Pureland dia origami misy ny fepetra fa indray mamalona ihany isaky ny mandeha, ny fivalonana sarotra kokoa tahaka ny valona mivadika dia tsy azo atao, ary ny fivalonana rehetra dia mipetraka mahitsy tsara.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Izy io dia namboarin’i John Smith tamin’ny taona 1970 mba hanampiana ireo mpamoritra tsy za-draharaha na ireo izay voafetra ny fihetsehan'ny vatany.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Mbola kely ny ankizy dia mahatsapa ny resaka volon-koditra sy ny fitsarana fahatany momba ny firazanana ka misy fiantraikany eo amin’ny fihetsika izany fitsarana fahatany izany.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Ohatra, ireo ankizy mahatsapa tena ho anatina foko vitsy an’isa izay voatsaratsara fahatany ho tsy dia mahay an-dakilasy dia lasa tsy mahay ao am-pianarana rehefa fantany ny momba ilay fitsaratsarana ivelany mifandray amin’ny firazanany.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Tsy hoe tsy fahafahana mianatra izany fa fikorontanana amin’ny fianarana ; mitranga amin’ny 3 ka hatramin’ny 5 isan-jaton’ny ankizy izany, angamba eo ho eo amin’ny 2 tapitrisa amin’ny ankizy Amerikanina.
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Sahirana ny ankizy voan’ny ADD voa mahavitra mifantoka any an-tsekoly, fa afaka mifantoka izy amin’ny zavatra tiany atao toy ny milalao, mijery sary miaina, na manoratra lahatsoratra tsy misy mari-piatoana.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Mazàna no manana olana foana ireto ankizy ireto, satria ” manao fihetsika mampidi-doza azy ireo, miditra anaty ady, miantsy ady amin’ny manampahefana “ mba hampiasana ny atidohany, satria tsy mety miasa amin’ny zavatra mahazatra intsony ny atidohany.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: Ny ADD dia misy fiantraikany eo amin’ny fifandraisana amin’ny namana satria ny ankizy sasany dia tsy afaka mahazo hoe nahoana no mitondra tena tahaka ny ataony izy ireo na hoe nahoana no miteny tahaka ny ataony izy ireo na koa hoe samy hafa ny fahamatorany.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Mandreraka be izany, toy ny hoe hifoha isaky ny roapolo minitra na antsasak’adiny ianao mba hijery tele.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Ny akony dia miankina amin’ny hoe impiry ny sainao no manandrana manao "rêve lucide" isan’alina.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Raha toa ka ny hamantatra ny tantara sy kolontsaina no tanjon’ny olona iray rehefa mitsidika toerana iray dia fitsidihana koltoraly no iantsoana izany.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Ny mpanjanaka, rehefa nahita ity hetsika ity, dia niantso fanamafisana.

text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Ny fomba fisakafoana ara-dalana fotsiny ihany dia tsy afaka hahazoana ny lentan’ireo matihanina, kanefa kosa izany dia afaka mampisy fiantraikany mivaingana amin’ny fahasalamana ankapoben’ireo atleta zandriny.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Ny fiezahana handanjalanja ny fampiasany ny heriny, ny fahazarana misotro rano, ary ny fiezahana hahatakatra ireo lafiny maro amin’ny fomba fanomezana otrikaina fanampiny ny vatana dia hanampy ny atleta hanatsara ny zava-bitany sy hampitombo ny fankafizany ny fanatanjahantena.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Afaka vidiana araka izay ilana azy ny vokatra, fa ny ankamaroany dia kely na tsy misy fiantraikany amin’ny zava-bita akory aza.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Ny atoma dia azo heverina ho isan’ireo vato fanorenana fototry ny zavatra rehetra.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Zavatra iray izay tena be pitsony izy io, ary araka ny modely notsorin’i Bohr, izay ahitana votoatiny foibe ihodidinan’ny elektrôna, izay tahaka ny mitovy ihany amin’ireo planeta mihodidina ny masoantro – jereo Sary 1.1
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Misy singa roa ny nucleus- neutrons sy protons.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Ny Protons dia voafahana aratra mihabo, ny neutrons kosa dia tsy misy fahana. Ny electrons kosa dia voafahana aratra mihiba.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Mba hahafahana mijery ilay niharamboina dia tsy maintsy manadihady ilay toerana nitrangan’ny loza aloha ianao mba ho fiarovana ny ainao.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Mila faritanao tsara ny toerana misy ilay niharam-boina sy izay fambara loza mazava rehetra rehefa manatona azy ianao.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Raha maratra eo am-panampiana ianao, vao maika ianao hanasaro-javatra.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Ny fikarohana dia nahitana fa ny fahaketrahana, ny tahotra sy ny loza dia mifandray amin’ny fanaintainana sy ny tsy fahatomombanana amin’ny olona marary lamosina.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Ny vokatry ny fieritreretana loza diso tafahoatra no ilàna fanaovana asa ara-batana isan-kerinandro tsy tapaka, fa tsy ny fahaketrahana na ny tahotra.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Ireo izay mampiasa vatana tsy tapaka dia nila fanohanana bebe kokoa amin’ny resaka fandraisana ratsy ny fanaintainana, manavaka ny fanaintainana miverimberina sy ny tsy fahazoana aina amin’ny fihetsiky ny vatana mahazatra.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Ny fahitana, na ny fahafahana mahita dia miankina amin’ireo taova fitsapana anatin’ny rafi-pijerena na ny maso.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Misy karazany rafitra maro ny maso, milahatra arakaraky ny fahasarotany miankina amin’ny filan’ny taova.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Ireo karazana fanorenana dia manana ny fahaizamanaony avy, izay mamaly amin’ny refin’onja samy hafa ary manana ambaratongam-pahatsapana samy hafa, izy ireo koa dia mitaky fikirakiràna samy hafa mba hampisy dikany ny zavatra ampidirina ao aminy ary isa samy hafa mba hiasàny araka izay mety indrindra.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Ny atao hoe mponina dia fitambaran'ny zavamananaina ana karazana iray anatina toerana iray voafaritra.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Rehefa manaraka endrikendrika phénotype iray manokana avokoa ny tsirairay dia izay no atao hoe monomorphe.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Rehefa misy olona iray mampiseho ireo toetoetrany manokana izay ananany dia atao fa hoe polymorphic.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Ny tafiky ny vitsika dia mandeha sy manoron-day manaraka ambaratonga samihafa.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Eo amin’ny dingana fifindra-monina, ny vitsika miaramila dia mandeha amin’ny alina ary mijanona mba hitoby mandritry ny andro.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.
