text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Maharitra eo amin’ny 17 andro eo ho eo ireo fandravaravana na diaben’ny mpifindramonina ireo.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Inona ny atao hoe sela? Io teny io dia avy amin’ny latina hoe “cella”, izay midika hoe “efitra kely”, ary mikroskopista iray no namorona izany rehefa nandinika ny firafitry ny bosoa izy.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Ny sela no singa fototry ny zavamanan’aina rehetra, ary ny zava-drehetra dia misy sela iray na mihoatra.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Fototra sy tsy azo ihodivirana eo amin’ny fianarana ny momba ny aina ny sela, raha ny marina, ka matetika dia antsoina hoe “ireo bonga manorina ny aina”.
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Mihazona hôméôstazy ny rafi-pitatitra haingam-pamaly baiko rehefa mandefa hafatra any amin’ny hozatry ny vatana iray manontolo mba hihazonana ny fikorianan’ny rà tsy hiovaova.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Afaka alefa haingana manerana ny vatana ireo tsindrin’ny tsira-pitatitra ireo izay miaro ny vatana amin’ny izay mety ho ambana.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Nikasika faritra kelikely ny tafio-drivotra raha oharina amin’ny tafiotra mahery hafa, kanefa afaka manimba izay rehetra lalovany.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Mampiongotra hazo ny tafiodrivotra, manendaka hazo amin’ny trano, mampisidina fiara eny amin’ny lanitra. Maharitra mihoatra ny adiny telo ny roa isan-jatony tena mahery amin’ny tafiotra.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Ny rivo-doza mahery vaika dia nandrivotra hatramin’ny 480 km/ora (133m/segondra; 300 mph).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Efa nanamboatra sy nampiasa fitaratra fanalehibiazana efa ho aman’arivony taona.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Na izany aza, ny tena teleskaopy voalohany dia namboarina tao Eorôpa tamin’ny faran’ny taonjato faha 16.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Mampiasa vera anakiroa izay mahatonga ny zavatra lavitra ho toy ny akaiky kokoa sy lehibe kokoa ireo teleskaopy ireo.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Ho eo amintsika foana ny fitiavan-karena mihoa-pampana sy ny fitiavan-tena ary toetry ny fiarahamiasa ny hoe rehefa mahazo tombony ny maro dia mbola hisy foana ny tombony misimisy kokoa azo amin’ny fotoana fohy amin’ny fanaovana fihetsika feno fitiavan-tena.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Enga anie ka ho takatry ny ankamaroan’ny olona ihany fa ny safidy tsara indrindra afaka ataony maharitra dia ny miara-miasa amin’ny hafa.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Olona maro no manonofy ny andro izay hahafahan’ny olombelona handeha eny amin’ny kintana hafa sy hikaroka tontolo vaovao, olona maro no manontany tena hoe inona no misy eny, ny sasany kosa dia mino ny fisian’ny aliens na fiainana hafa mety misy eny amin’ny planeta hafa.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Fa na hisy aza izany dia tsy hisy alohan’ny fotoana ela be. Mifanalavitra loatra ny kintana, hany ka na ireo kintana atao hoe “mpifanolobodirindrina” aza dia mifanalavitra an-davitrisa kilaometatra maromaro.
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Mety hoe any andro iray, hitsangana eny an-tampona tontolo ivelan'ny tany ny zafindohalikao dia hanontany tena momba ny razambeny taloha ?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Manana sela maro be ny biby. Mihinan-javatra izy ireny ary mandevona izany any anatiny. Afaka mihetsika ny ankamaroan’ny biby.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Ny biby ihany no manana atidoha (na dia tsy hoe manana daholo aza ny biby rehetra; toy ny horitalahy izao dia tsy misy atidoha).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Ahitana biby manerana ny tany iray manontolo. Mandavaka ny tany, milomano an-dranomasina, ary manidina eny amin’ny habakabaka.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Ny sela no singa manana rafitra sy miasa kely indrindra ao anatin’ny zavamanan’aina (zavatra).
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Ny teny hoe "cell" (sela) dia avy amin’ny teny latina hoe "cella" izay midika hoe efitra kely.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Raha mandinika zava-manan'aina amin’ny mikiraosikaopy ianao dia ho hitanao fa  efa-joro na baolina kely no mandrafitra azy ireo.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, biolojista avy any Angletera, dia nahita efa-joro tamin’ny bosoa tamin’ny mikroskopy.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Tahaka ny efitra ireo. Izy no olona voalohany nandinika sela maty.
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Ny singa sy ireo fangarony dia afaka mivadika amin’ny toetoetra iray ho amin’ny iray hafa ary tsy miova.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Ny nitirôzenina rivotra dia mitovy toetra amin’ny nitirôzenina ranony ihany. Matevina kokoa ilay ranony fa ny môlekiola dia mitovy ihany.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Ohatra iray hafa ny rano. Atôman'hidirôzenina roa sy atôman'oksizenina iray no mandrafitra ny taharo simika rano.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Mitovy ny rafitra molekolariny na etona izy na matsora na mivaingana.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Na dia mety hiova aza ny toetrany ara-fizika dia tsy miova ny toetrany ara-simika.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Ny fotoana dia zavatra iray manodidina antsika, ary miantraika amin’ny ataontsika rehetra, nefa dia sarotra ny mahatakatra tsara azy.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Ny fotoana dia nianaran’ireo relijiozy, filozofy, ary mpandinika ara-tsiansa an’arivon-taonany.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Miaina ny fotoana toy ny fitohizan-javatra izay mandeha avy amin’ny ho avy mankaty amin’ny ankehitriny ary mankany amin’ny lasa isika.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Ny fotoana ihany koa dia ny fomba ampitahaintsika ny faharetan’ireo (halava) tranga.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Azonao marihina ny fandalovan’ny fotoana amin’ny fandinihanao ny tranga mitsingerina. Ny tranga mitsingerina dia ny zavatra miverimberina mitranga tsy tapaka.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Ny solosaina amin’izao fotoana izao dia ampiasaina mba hikirakirana sary sy horonan-tsary.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Afaka amboarina amin’ny solosaina ny sarimiaina avo lenta, ary mihamitombo ny fampiasana izany karazana sarimiaina izany anaty fahitalavitra sy horonantsary.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Matetika ny mozika dia alaina feo amin'ny fampiasana solosaina raitra amin’ny fikirakirana sy ny fanakambanana ireo feo.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Fotoana ela nandritra ny taonjato fahasivy ambin’ny folo sy roapolo dia noheverina fa ny Maoris no mponina voalohany tao Novely Zelandy, izay nihaza vorom-be antsoina hoe moas.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Ny teoria dia mailaza fa ny mponina tao Maori dia nifindra monina avy ao Polynezia tamin’ny sambo lehibe ary naka an’i Nouvelle Zélande tamin’i Moriori, ka nanangana fiaraha-monina mpamboly.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Na izany aza, misy porofo vaovao milaza fa ny Moriori dia vondron’ny Maori an-tanibe avy any Nouvelle-Zélande nifindra tao amin’ireo nosy Chatham, nampivoatra ny kolontsainy miavaka sy milamina.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Nisy foko hafa ihany koa tao amin’ny nosy Chatham izany dia ny Maori izay niala avy ao Nouvelle Zélande.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Moriori no niantsoany ny tenany; nisy ady madinidinika ary ny farany dia foana ny Moriori.
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Ny olona izay efa tao anatiny amam-polo taonany maro dia nanampy anay hisitraka ny herinay sy ny zavatra ankafizinay no sady mijery ireo fahasahiranana eny fa na dia ny tsy fahombiazana aza.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Rehefa mihaino ny olona miresaka momba ny tantarany manokana, ny fianakaviany na ny fikambanany izahay dia lasa nahafantatra zavatra maro momba ny lasa sy ny olona nahatonga ny kolontsain’ilay fikambanana ho lasa tsara na ratsy.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Na dia tsy midika fahazoana ny kolontsaina aza ny fahatakarana ny tantaran'ny olona iray, dia farafaharatsiny manampy ny olona hahazo an-tsaina ny toerana misy azy amin’ny tantaran’ny fikambanana izany.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Rehefa manaiky ny fahombiazana amin’ny fahafantarana ny fahalavoana, ny tsirairay sy ny rehetra amin’ny olona izay mandray anjara dia mahita lalindalina kokoa ny lanjany, ny iraka sy ny tosiky ny fikambanana.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Amin’ity tranga iray ity, nanampy ny olona hisokatra amin'ny fiovàna vaovao sy lalana vaovao ho an'ny fiangonana ao an-toerana ny fitadidiana ireo ohatra teo aloha momba ny fitondrantena eo amin'ny fandraharahana sy ireo fahombiazana azo tamin'izany.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Ny tantaram-pahombiazana tahaka ity dia mampihena ny tahotra amin’ny fiovana, no sady mampitsiry faniriana miabo mankany amin’ny fiovana amin’ny hoavy.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Ireo sarin-tsaina mifameno dia tekinika famahana olana izay manambatra ireo hevitra na sehatra samihafa ahitam-bahaolana.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Mifantoka amin'ny hafainganana, ny lôjika sy ny fahamarinana ity fomba fisainana ity, ary koa ny famantarana ny zavamisy, ny famerenana mampihatra ireo teknika efa misy, ny fanangonana fampahalalana.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Ny singa lehibe indrindra amin’io fomba fisainana io dia: iray ihany no valin-teny marina. Valiny roa ihany no eritreretinao, na marina na diso.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Mifandray amina fomba fanao mahazatra na siansa iray manokana izany karazana fisainana izany.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Ny olona manana izany fomba fisainana izany dia manana fomba fisainana lojika, afaka mitadidy lasitra, mamaha olana sy miasa amin’ny andrana siantifika.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Ny olombelona hatreto no karazana manan-talenta indrindra amin’ny famakiana ny any an-tsain’ny hafa.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Midika izany fa afaka maminavina tsara izay tsapan’ny olombelona hafa, na kasainy, inoany, fantany na iriny isika.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Amin’ireo fahaizana maro ireo, dia tena ilaina ny fahaizana mahatakatra ny ao an-tsain’ny hafa. Ahafahantsika mamaha ny fanjavozavon'ny hetsika ara-batana izany.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Ohatra, raha mahita olona iray mamaky fitaratry ny fiara ianao, dia hilaza ianao fa mangalatra fiaran’olona izy.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Hafa no fomba hitsarana azy raha toa ka very ny lakilen’ny fiarany ary fiarany ihany no nopitsohany.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: Ny IRM dia mifototra amin’ny tranga fizika antsoina hoe resonance magnétique niokleary (RMN), izay hitan’i Felix Bloch (niasa tao amin’ny Anjerimanontolon'i Stanford) sy i Edward Purcell (avy ao amin’ny Anjerimanontolo Harvard) voalohany tany amin’ny taona 1930 tany.
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Amin’ity ako ity, mahatonga ny ataoma hanome signaux radio madinika ny sahan’andriamby sy ireo onjan’ny radio.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Tamin’ny taona 1970 no nahitan’I Raymond Damadian, dokotera sady mpikaroka siantifika, ny fototry ny fampiasana ny fitarafana amin’ny alalan’ny resonance magnétique mba ho fitaovana fanaovana fitiliana eo amin’ny sehatry ny fitsaboana.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Nisy patanty navoaka efa-taona tatỳ aoriana, izay no patanty voalohany nomena tamin’ny resaka MRI.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Tamin’ny 1977 ny Dr Damadian dia namarana ny fanamboarana ny skanera IRM voalohany “ho an'ny tena manontolo”, izay nantsoiny hoe “Indomitable”.
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Ny fifandraisana tsy miaraka dia mandrisika ny fakana fotoana hieritreretana sy hamaliana ny hafa.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Izany dia mamela ireo mpianatra hianatra amin’ny gadony manokana sy mifehy ny hafainganan’ny fahalalana ara-panabeazana.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Ho fanampin'izay, vitsy ny famerana fotoana ary malalaka sy afaka miova ny ora iasana. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Mamela ny mpianatra hanana fidirana amin’ny fampahalalana amin’ny fotoana rehetra ny fampiasana ny Aterineto sy ny Tranonkala Manerana ny Tany.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Afaka mandefa fanontaniana amin’ny mpampianatra ihany koa ny mpianatra amin’ny fotoana rehetra ary afaka manantena valiny haingana araka izay azo ato, fa tsy hoe hiandry ny fivoriana imaso manaraka.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Ny aorian’ny maoderina amin’ny fampianarana dia manolotra fahafahana amin’ny tsy azo hozongozonina. Tsy misy fomba tokana tsara amin’ny fianarana.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Raha ny marina, tsy misy zavatra tokana tsara ianarana. Ny fianarana dia mitranga anatin’ny fifanatrehan’ilay mpianatra sy ny fahalalana izay atolotra.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Ny zavatra iainantsika ankehitriny miaraka amin’ny ianao ihany no manao izany, ny fanehoana ny andinindininy, fahitalavitra mifototra amin’ny fianarana dia maneho izany teboka izany.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Maro amintsika no lasa mijery fandaharana amin’ny fahitalavitra izay mampahafantatra ny fizotran-javatra na traikefa izay tsy andraisantsika anjara akory sy tsy ho ampiasaintsika mandrakizay.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Tsy hanamboatra fiara mihitsy isika, na hanisy loharano eo an-jaridainantsika, na hitsidika an’i Però mba hijery ireo sisam-paharavana tavela, na hanavao ny tranon’ny mpifanolobodirindrina amintsika.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Noho ireo kabla vita amin’ny fitaratra na plastika mampita hazavana napetraka ambany ranomasina mampifandray amin’i Eoropa sy ny zanabolana mampitombo ny hafainganam-pandeha, dia mifandray tsara ny ao Greenland, ny 93%-n'ny mponina izay manana aterineto.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Ny hotely misy anao na ny mpampiantrano (raha toa ka trano fandraisam-bahiny na tranon’olona no ipetrahanao) dia tokony hanana wifi na solosaina misy aterineto, ary ny toerana rehetra dia ahitana cybercafe na toerana sasany misy wifi ho an’ny daholobe.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Araka ny voalaza eo ambony, na dia ekena any Etazonia ary ny teny hoe “Eskimo”, dia heverin’ireo vahoaka tsy Amerikanina any Arktika, indrindra any Kanadà ho fanambaniana izany.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Raha mety ho renao ny teny ampiasan’ireo teratany avy ao Greenland, dia tsy tokony hampiasa azy ireo mpivahiny.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: “Inuit” no fiantsoan’ireo olona avy any Groenlandy ny tenany rehefa ao Kanadà sy Kalaalleq (filaza maro :Kalaallit), fa Groenlandey kosa raha ao Groenlandy.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Ny heloka be vava, sy ny eritreri-dratsy manoloana ny vahiny dia tsy misy ao Greenland. Na amin’ny tanàn-dehibe aza dia tsy misy “toerana mafana”.
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Ny toetrandro mangatsiaka no mety hany tena ho loza hatrehin’ireo izay tsy niomana.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Raha mitsidika an’i Groenlandy ianao mandritra ny ririnina (satria arakaraka ny andehananao mianavaratra no vao mainka mampangatsiaka kokoa ny andro), dia tena ilaina ny mitondra akanjo mafana tsara.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Mety hahatonga olana amin’ny tsy fahampiana torimaso sy olana ara-pahasalamana mifandraika amin’izay ny halavan’ny andro mandritra ny fahavaratra.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Mandritra ny fahavaratra, tandremo ihany koa ireo moka tavaratra. Na dia tsy mamindra aretina aza izy ireo dia mety hahasorena.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Na dia mifamatotra amin’ny maha-toerana fanaovana fizahan-tany mahasarika azy aza ny toe-karen’i San Francisco dia misy lafiny maro ihany ny toe-kareny.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Ireo sehatr’asa be mpiasa indrindra dia ny sampanasa matihanina, governemanta, fitantanambola, varotra, sy fizahantany.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Ny fanehoana azy matetika anatin’ny mozika, horonantsary, literatiora sy kolontsaina malaza dia nanampy tamin’ny fampahafantarana ny tanàna sy ny vakoka misy ao aminy manerana izao tontolo izao.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: Namboatra rafitra lehibe fandraisana mpizahatany i San Francisco miaraka amin’ny hotely maro, toerana fisakafoana, ary toerana fanaovana fivoriambe maro avo lenta.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: Toerana iray anisan’ny tsara indrindra eo amin’ny firenena amin’ny nahandro Aziatika ihany koa i San Francisco: Kôreanina, Thai, Indianina, sy Zaponey.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Ny fandehanana any amin’ny Disney land dia karazana fivanihanana masina ho an’ny ankamaroan’ny fianakaviana Amerikanina.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Ny fitsidihana “miavaka” dia ny mandray sidina eny amin’ny seranam-piaramanidin’i Orlando, mandeha fiara fitateram-bahoaka mankany amin’ny toerana fandraisam-bahinin’ny Disney, mandany herinandro maninjitra tsy miala ao amin’ny faritry Disney, ary miverina mody.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Misy endriny maro tsy voatanisa azo lazaina, fa ity no tian’ny ankamaroan’ny olona ambara rehefa miteny hoe “ho any amin’ny Disney World”.
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Maro amin’ireo tapakila amidy an-tserasera toy ny amin’ny eBay na Craigslist no tapakila park-hopper manan-kery andro maromaro izay efa niasa amin’ny ampahany.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Fomba fanao tena ratsy ity, noraran’i Disney: Tsy azo afindra ny tapakila.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Mila fahazoandalana hampiasa ny tany lavitra andriana ny olona vao mahazo milasy eo ambanin'ny moron'ny Grand Canyon.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Voafetra ny fahazoandalana noho ny fiarovana ilay hadilanana, ary azo alaina amin'ny andro voalohan’ny volana, efa-bolana mialoha ny volana fiandohana.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Noho izany, ny fahazoandalana hampiasa tany lavitra andriana ho an'izay daty fanombohana rehetra amin'ny volana May dia efa azo fandrihana manomboka ny 1 Jan.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Vao manomboka ny fisoratana anarana hitsika an’ireotoerana malaza indrindra, toa an’i Bright Angel Campground mifanaraka amin’ny Phantom Ranch, dia efa feno ny famandrihana amin’iny andro voalohany iny.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Voafetra ny isan’ny fahazoan-dalana voatokana ho an’ny fangatahana-mandeha araka ny fitsipika tonga voalohany, izay tonga voalohany no mahazo.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Ny fidirana ny faritra atsimon’i Afrika amin’ny fiara dia fomba iray mahavariana hijerena ny hatsara rehetran’ny faritra sy handehanana any amin’ny toerana tsy anatin’ny lalan’ny mpizahatany mahazatra.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Ity dia azo atao amina fiara tsotra miaraka amin’ny programa voatandrina fa ny 4x4 no tena ampirisinina ary betsaka ny toerana tsy tonga raha tsy amin’ny 4x4 misy kodiarana avo.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Tadidio rehefa manao drafitra fa na dia milamina aza ny faritra atsimon’i Afrika dia tsy ny firenena rehetra manodidina no tahaka izany.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Miovaova isaky ny firenena ny fepetra amin’ny vizà sy ny vidiny, ary miankina amin’ny firenena niavianao koa izany.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Ny firenena tsirairay dia manana ny lalànany manokana izay mandidy hoe inona ny fitaovana vonjy taitra ilaina anaty fiara.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Ny Riandrano Viktoria dia tanàna ao amin’ny ampahany avaratry Zimbaboe, manerana ny sisin-tany avy amin’ny Livingstone, Zambia, ary akaiky ny Botsoana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Tonga dia eo akaikin’ny riandrano no misy an’ilay tanna, ary izy io no tena mahasarika olona indrindra, fa ity toerana malaza ity dia misy, ho an’ireo te hanandrana zava-baovao sy mpikaroka, zavatra maro hahatonga azy ireo hijanona elaela ao.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Amin’ny fahavaratra (Novambra hatramin’ny Martsa), ho avo kokoa ny habetsahan’ny rano ary ny ho dramatika kokoa ny rian-drano.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Azo antoka fa ho lena ianao raha miampita amin’ny tetezana na mandeha amin’ilay lalan-kely akaikin’ny riandrano.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Amin’ny lafiny iray, nohon’ny fahahavon’ny halehiben’ny rano no mahatonga anao mahita ny fianjerana ankehitriny ho maizina amin’ireo rano rehetra!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Fasan’i Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 angamba no fasana malaza indrindra amin’ny fasan’ny lohasaha rehetra, ilay nahitan’i Howard Carter tamin’ny taona 1922 ny nandevenana ilay mpanjaka tanora saika tsy nisy fahasimbana mihitsy.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Raha ampitahaina amin’ny ankamaroan’ireo fasan’ny mpanjaka hafa, anefa, dia zara raha mendrika hotsidihina ny fasan’i Tutankhaman, satria kely lavitra no sady vitsy ny haingony.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Ireo rehetra zay liana ny hahita porofon’ny fahasimbana nahazo ilay "momie" nandritra ireo andrana hanesorana azy tao amin’ilay vatapaty dia ho diso fanantenana satria ny loha sy ny soroka ihany no tazana.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Tsy ao intsony ny harena be tao amin’ny fasana, fa nafindra tany amin’ny trano tahiry Egiptianina ao Kairo.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Ny mpitsidika voafetra ara-potoana dia tsara indrindra raha mandany ny fotoanany any amin’ny toeran-kafa.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 km atsimo andrefan’i Siem Reamp. Ity tempoly eny an-tampon-kavoana ity dia naorina tamin’ny faran'ny taonjato faha-9, nandritra ny fanjakan’ny Mpanjakalahy Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Ny rivotra manjombona ao amin’ny tempoly sy ny fahitana ny farihy Tonle Sap avy ety ambony dia mahatonga ny fihanihana ny havoana ho tsy anenenana.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Ny fitsidihana ilay toerana dia azo ampiarahana tsara amina fitsangatsanganana an-tsambo eny ambony farihy.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Ny tapakila fidirana ao Angkor dia ilaina mba hidirana ny tempoly, ka aza adino ny mitondra ny pasipaoro miaraka aminao rehefa mandeha any amin’ny Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jerosalema no renivohitra sy tànana lehibe indrindra ao Israely, na dia tsy mandray azy ho renivohitr’Israely aza ny ankamaroan’ny firenena sy ny firenena mikambana.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Ny tanàna antitra ao Judean Hills dia manana tantara mahavariana efa ho arivo taona maro.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Masina io tanàna io noho ny fivavahana telo mivavaka amin’andriamanitra iray : fivavahana Jodaisma, fivavahana Kristianina ary fivavahana Silamo, ary io toerana io ihany koa dia ivon-toerana ara-panahy, ara-pivavahana ary ara-kolontsaina.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Noho ny lanjany ara-pivavahana, ary indrindra amin’ireo toerana efa tranainy ao amin’ny tanànany, dia anisan’ny toerana mahasarika mpizaha tany sy be mpandeha indrindra any Israely i Jerosalema.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jerosalema dia manana toerana afaka tsidihina amin’ny lafiny tantara, arkeôlôjia ary kolontsaina, miaraka amin’ny toeram-pietsenana, fisotrosotroana ary fisakafoanana mihetsiketsika sy feno olona.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Takian’i Ekoatora ny hahazoan’ny mponina Kiobana taratasy fanasàna mialoha ny hidirany an’i Ekoatora amin’ny alalan’ny seranam-piaramanidina iraisam-pirenena na ireo toerana fidirana ny sisintany.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Ity taratasy ity dia tsy maintsy voamarina ara-dalàna ao amin’ny Minisitry ny Raharaham-Bahiny Ekoatoriana, ary mifanaraka amin’ny fepetra sasany.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Ireo fepetra ireo dia natao mba hisian’ny fifindra-monina milamina eo amin’ireo firenena anankiroa.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Tokony manantona Masoivoho ekoatorianina ireo olom-pirenena kiobàna manana karatra maitso amerikanina mba tsy hiaran’io fitakiana io.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Tsy maintsy manan-kery 6 volana ao aorian’ny datin’ny dianao ny pasipaoronao raha kely indrindra. Tapakila mandroso sy miverina no ilaina hanamarinana ny faharetan’ny fijanonanao.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Mora kokoa ny fitsidihana ho an’ny vondron’olona maromaro, koa raha mandeha irery ianao na miampy namana iray monja, miezaha mitady olona hafa ary mitambara ho vondron’olona efatra ka hatramin’ny enina mba ho mora kokoa ny vidiny ho an’ny olona iray.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Tsy tokony hanelingelina be anareo anefa izany satria matetika dia ampiarahana ny mpizaha tany samihafa mba hamenoana ny fiara.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Raha ny marina izy io dia toa fomba amitahana olona amin'ny finoana fa tsy maintsy mandoa vola mihoatra izy ireo.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Manerinerina ny sisiny avaratr’i Machu Picchu no misy ity tendrombohitra mideza ity, izay matetika tazana aorian'ny sary maro misy ireo sisam-paharavana tavela.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Mahakivy ihany ilay izy avy aty ambany, sady fiakarana mideza sy sarotra, saingy ny ankamaroan'ny olona salama vatana tsara dia tokony hahavita azy anatin’ny 45 minitra.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Misy tohatra vita amin’ny vato ny ankamaroan’ilay lalana, ary amin’ireo faritra maranitra kokoa dia misy tariby natao hifikiran’ny tanana ilay lalana.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Fa na izany aza, miomana ihany ho reraka be, ary tandremo ireo ampahany tena mitsatoka be, indrindra rehefa mando iny izy, satria mety hampidi-doza haingana be izany.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Misy lavabato kiritika izay tsy maintsy lalovana akaikin'ny tampony, ambany ihany izy io no sady somary tery.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Ny fomba tsara indrindra ahitana ireo toerana sy ireo zavaboarin’ny Galapagos dia eny ambony sambo, tahaka ny nataon’i Charles Darwin tamin’ny 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Sambo mihoatra ny 60 no mandeha amin’ny rano Galapagos – izay mahazaka mpandeha 8 hatramin’ny 100.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Ny ankamaroan’ny olona dia mamandrika ny toerana mialoha (satria matetika dia feno ny sambo rehefa vanim-potoana mahabe ny olona manao fitsidihana ).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Alao antoka fa ny olona anaovanao famandrihana dia mpandinika manokana momba ny Galapagos izay manana fahalalana tsara mandrakotra karazana sambo maro.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Izany dia hiantoka fa ny zavatra mahalina sy/na manelingelina anao manokana dia samy hipetraka amin’izay sambo tandrify azy.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Talohan’ny nahatongavan’ireo Espaniola tamin’ny taonjato faha 16, ny Inca no nitondra an’i Silia avaratra raha nipetraka tao Silia afovoany sy atsimo kosa ireo tompon-tanàna Araucaniens (Mapuche).
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Ny Mapuche dia anisan’ny vondrona tompon-toerana Amerikana farany, izay tsy voafehin’ny fananapahana espaniola tanteraka raha tsy taorian’ny nahazoan’I Chili ny fahaleovan-tenany.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Na dia nanambara ny fahaleovan-tenany aza ny Silia ny 1810 (nandritry ny ady tamin’ny andron’i Napoleona izay nahatonga an’i Espaina tsy isy governemanta niasa nandritra ny roa taona), dia tsy resiny tanteraka i Espaina raha tsy tamin’ny 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Ny Repoblika Dominikanina (amin’ny teny espaniola hoe República Dominicana) dia firenena Karaiba, mameno ny antsasaky ny faritra antsinanan’ny nosin’ny Hispaniola, izay itambarany amin’i Haiti.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Ankoatra ny torapasika fotsy sy ny tendrombohitra, ilay firenena dia tanindrazan'ny tanàna antitra indrindra an'ireo eoropeana  tao Amerika , izay ankehitriny tafiditra ao anatin’i Santo Domingo.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Ny Taínos sy Caribes no nipetraka voalohany tao amin’ny nosy. Ny Caribes dia olona miteny Arawakan izay tonga 10 000 taona talohan’ny Kristy.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Taona vitsy monja taorian’ny nahatongavan’ny mpamaky lay eoropeana no nahitana fihenana be ny mponin’i Tainos noho ny mpanafika espaniola.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Raha mifototra amin’i Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) teo anelanelan’ny 1492 sy 1498 dia namono Taínos manodidina ny 100000 teo ny mpanafika Espaniola.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Io toerana io dia natsangana ho tokontany anatin'ny tranon-drelijiozy iray tamin’ny taonjato faha-17, izay ny Templo de San Diego sisa no tranobe mbola mitsangana.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Miasa tahaka ny fitsangantsanganana an-tanann-dehibe izao ity ary misy zava miseho foana, andro aman’alina.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Misimisy ihany ny toerana fihinanan-kanina manodidina ny zaridaina, sady amin’ny tolakandro sy amin’ny hariva matetika dia misy fampisehoana maimaimpoana avy eo amin’ny gazebo afovoany.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beson (araben’ny oroka ): lavarangana roa zarain’ny 69 sentimetatra dia tranon’ny olona miavaka.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Ilavoamena vitsivitsy fotsiny no omenao azy dia hilaza aminao ny tantara ny sasany amin’ireo ankizy.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Ny nosy Bowen dia fitsidika andro iray na fitsangatsanganana faran’ny herinandro izay misy fandehanana kayak, fanaovana dia tongotra lavitra, fivarotana, toerana fisakafoana, sy ny maro hafa koa.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Ity vondrompiarahamonina tena avy ao an-toerana ity dia ao Howe Sound, tsy lavitra an’i Vancouver, ary mora haleha amin’ny lakana taxi manara-potoana alaina ao amin’ny Nosy Granville ao afovoan-tanànan’i Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Ho an’ireo izay tia fialam-boly any ivelany, dia tena zava-dehibe ny fanaovana diabe any amin’ny lalantsaran’i Sea mankany Sky.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Lafo fiainana i Whistler (1.5 ora an-taomobilina miala an’i Vancouver) fa be mpahafantatra noho ny Lalao Olaimpikan-dririnina tamin’ny taona 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Rehefa ririnina, ankafizo ny fanaovana ski tsara indrindra ao Amerika Avaratra, ary rehefa fahavaratra indray dia andramo ny fitaingenana bisikileta an-tendrombohitra araka ny fombandrazana.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Tsy maintsy voafandrika mialoha ny fahazoan-dàlana. Mila manana fahazoan-dàlana ianao raha te hijanona alina ao Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena no tobin'ny mpiambina valanjavaboary hany misy fatoriana sy sakafo mafana ankoatra ny fitobiana. La Leona, San Pedrillo, sy Los Patos dia fitobiana ihany no misy ao fa tsy misy sakafo.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Azo atao ny mahazo mivantana ny fahazoandàlana hitsidika ny valanjavaboahary avy ao amin’ny Tobin’ny Mpiambina ny Valanjavaboary ao Puerto Jiménez, fa izy ireo anefa tsy mandray kara-bola.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Ny Sampandraharahan'ny Valanjavaboary (MINAE) dia tsy manome fahazoandàlana mihoatra ny iray volana alohan’ny tena fahatongavana.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol dia manome tolotra famandrihana amin’ny vidiny $30 amerikana, na $10 ho an’ny andro iray; fanazavana eo amin’ny pejin’izy ireo Corcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Ny Nosy Cook dia nosy firenena anatin’ny fikambanana malalaka miaraka amin’ny Novely Zelandy, hita any Polinezia, eo ampovoan’ny Ranomasimbe Pasifika Atsimo.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Izy io dia toerana ahitana vondronosy miisa 15 miparitaka amin’ny ranomasimbe 2,2 tapitrisa kilaometatra toradroa.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Mitovy amin’ny ora any Hawaii, ary indraindray dia noheverina fa “ambanin’ny Hawaii” no misy an’ilay nosy.
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Na dia kely kokoa aza izy io dia mampahatsiaro ireo mpitsidika zokinjokiny sasany an’i Hawaï talohan’ny niforonan'ny fanjakana tsy misy ireo hôtely lehibe ho an’ny mpizahatany sy ireo fandrosoana hafa rehetra.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Ny Nosy Cook dia tsy misy tanàna akory fa voarafitra nosy 15 samihafa. Rarotonga sy Aitotaky no voalohany ngeza indrindra amin’izy ireo.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Amin’izao fotoana izao any amin’ny firenena mandroso, ny famatsiana fandriana raitra sy sakafo maraina dia nasondrotra ho karazana haikanto.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Any amin’ny farany ambony dia mazava ho azy fa zavatra roa lehibe no tena ifaninanan’ny B&Bs : ny haifandriana sy ny sakafo maraina.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Araka izany, ao amin’ny toerana tsara indrindra ohatra ireo dia mety ahitana ny lambampandriana lafo vidy indrindra, ohatra hoe lamba firakotra bemiray vita tanana na fandriana vakoka.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Ny sakafo maraina dia mety ahitana sakafo fy amin’ny vanintaona ao amin’ny faritra na ny sakafo famantarana ny mpandray.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Mety hoe trano manan-tantara efa antitra ilay toerana miaraka amin’ny fanaka taloha be, tany voakarakara sy dobo filomanosana.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Ny fidirana anaty fiaranao ary mandeha alavitra dia midika faniriana anaty farak’izay tsotra.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Tsy tahaka ireo fiara lehibe, ianao dia mety ho efa zatra mamily ny fiaranao ary mahalala ny fetrany.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Ny fananganana lay amin’ny toerana misy tompony na amin’ny tanàna na ahoana na ahoana halehibeny dia mety hanintona olona tsy araka izay neritreretina.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Raha tsorina, fomba iray tena tsara hanaovana dia lavitra ny fampiasana ny fiaranao, saingy mahalana no maha-fomba “filasiana” azy.
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Azo atao ny milasy anaty fiara raha manana kamiao kely malalaka ianao, SUV, Sedan na Station Wagon misy seza azo ampandriana.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Ny hotely sasany dia nandova avy tamin’ny fotoam-pahasambarana nisian’ny lamasinina mandeha etona sy ny sambo mpitondra mpandeha an-dranomasimbe; talohan’ny Ady Lehibe Faharoa, tamin’ny taonjato faha-19 na ny voalohandohan’ny taonjato faha-20.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Ireo toerana fandraisam-bahiny ireo dia hipetrahan’ireo manan-karena sy malaza tamin’izany, ary matetika misakafo tsara sy manana mahafinaritra amin’ny alina.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Ny fikarakarana trano amin'ny fomba tranainy, ny tsy fahampian’ny fitaovana hiaka farany sy ny fahazoan-taona feno fahamendrehana dia anisan’ny toetran’izy ireo ihany koa.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Na dia tsy miankina aza ny tompon’izy ireny amin’ny ankapobeny dia indraindray mandray ireo lehibem-panjakana na manamboninahitra hafa mitsidika.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Ny mpanao dia lavitra iray manam-bola be dia mety manapa-kevitra ny hitety an’izao tontolo izao sady hijanona amin’ny hotely isan-karazany.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Ny atao hoe tambajotram-pifanakalozana fampiantranoana dia ireo fikambanana mampifandray ny mpivahiny amin’ireo olona mipetraka any amin’ny tanàndehibe hotsidihany.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Mazàna ny fidirana amina tambajotra toy io dia mitaky famenoana taratasy an-jotra fotsiny; na dia manolotra na mitaky fanamarinana fanampiny aza ny tambajotra sasany.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Misy lisitr’ireo mpampiantrano izay omena na an-taratasy na/an-jotra, indraindray miaraka amin’ny fanamarihana sy tatitra avy amin’ireo mpandeha hafa.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing dia noforonina tamin’ny Janoary 2004 rehefa avy nahita sidina mora mankany Iceland ilay mpandrindra informatika Casey Fenton fa tsy nahita toerana hijanonana nefa.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Nandefa mailaka tamin’ny mpianatra ao amin’ny anjerimanontolo ao an-toerana izy ary nahazo tolotra fampiantranoana maimaimpoana tsy tambo isaina.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Mitodika manokana amin’ny tanora ireo trano fandraisam-bahiny - olona manodidina ny roapolo taona izao no tena karazam-bahiny fahita ao - fa ahitana vahiny zokin’izany matetika ihany koa anefa ao.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Mahalana ny ahitana ankohonana miaraka amin’ny zaza, saingy misy hotely sasany tena mampiantrano azy ireny anaty efitrano mitokana.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Ny tanànan’i Beijing ao Sina no hampiantrano ny Lalao Olaimpikan-dririnina amin’ny 2022, izay mahatonga azy ho tanàna voalohany nampiantrano ny lalao olaimpikan’ny fahavaratra sy ririnina.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Handray ny lanonam-panokafana sy famaranana ary ireo hetsika ambony ranomandry izay hatao anaty trano i Beijing.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Hisy hetsika ski hafa ao amin’ny faritra Taizicheng ao Zhangjiakou, eo amin’ny 22 km (140 miles) miala an’i Beijing.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Ny ankamaroan’ireo tempoly dia manana ny fetibeny isan-taona tokoa, manomboka ny faran’ny volana Novambra ka hatramin’ny tapaky ny volana May, izay samihafa arakaraka ny tetiandron'ilay tempoly isan-taona.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Ny ankamaroan’ireo fetiben’ny tempoly dia ankalazaina ao anatin'ny tsingerintaonan’ny tempoly na ny tsingerintaonan’ilay andriamanitra miadidy azy na izay hetsika lehibe hafa rehetra mahakasika ny tempoly.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Ny fetin’ny tempolin’i Kerala dia tena mahaliana ny mijery azy, miaraka amin’ny filaharan’elefanta voahaingo, mpitendrin’ny tempoly ary hetsika fankalazana hafa.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Ny Foara manerantany (izay antsoina hoe Fampirantiana Manerantany na Expo fotsiny) dia fampisehoana iraisam-pirenena goavana momban’ny zava-kanto sy ny siansa.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Ny firenena mandray anjara dia maneho zava-kanto sy seho fanabeazana ao amin’ny sehatra nasionaly mba hanehoana olana iraisam-pirenena na ny kolontsaina sy tantaran’ny fireneny.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Ny Fampirantiana Voly Voninkazo Iraisam-pirenena dia hetsika manokana hanehoana ny endrik’ireo voninkazo, ireo zaridaina bôtanika sy ny zavatra hafa izay misy ifandraisany amin’ny zava-maniry.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Na dia mety hitranga isan-taona aza ireny ara-teoria (raha toa ka mitranga any amin’ny firenena samy hafa), ara-pratika izy ireny dia tsy afaka.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Ireny hetsika ireny dia maharitra eo amin’ny telo ka hatramin’ny enim-bolana eo raha ny tokony ho izy, ary atao eny amin’ny toerana izay tsy latsaky ny 50 hektara.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Karazany maro ireo andrefin'ny pellicule izay nampiasaina nandritra ny taona maro. Ny pellicule mahazatra 35 mm (porofontsary 36 amin’ny 24 mm) no tena fahita indrindra.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Tsotra ihany ny mameno an’io raha lany, ary manome hakitroka pixel mitovitovy amin’ny DSLR amin'izao.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Misy fakantsary sasany manana pellicule salasalany mampiasa ny refy 6 amin’ny 6 cm, ny marimarina kokoa porofontsary 56 amin’ny 56 mm.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Izany dia manome hazavana saika avo efatra heny nòho ny porofontsary 35 mm (3136 mm2 raha oharina amin’ny 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Ny bibidia dia anisan’ny lohahevitra mitondra fanamby goavana ho an’ny mpakasary ka mila fangarona vintana, faharetana, traikefa sy fitaovana tsara.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Eritreretina ho mandeha ho azy ny fakana sary ny biby ao an'ala matetika, kanefa, toy ny sary amin’ny ankapobeny rehetra, ny sary iray dia mahasolo teny arivo.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Matetika ny fakana sary ny bibidia dia mila téléobjectif, kanefa ny zavatra toy ny vorona manidina na zavamananaina kely bilitika dia mila objectifs hafa.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Betsaka ireo biby tsy mahazatra no sarotra hita, ary indraindray ireo valanjavaboary mametraka fitsipika momba ny fakàna sary noho ny antony ara-barotra.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Mety ho saro-kenatra na hahery setra ny bibidia. Ny tontolo iainana dia mety hangatsiaka na hafana, raha tsy izany dia mety tsy hahatamana mihitsy.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Misy fiteny 5 000 mahery eran-tany, anatin'izany misy roapolo mahery manana mpiteny 50 tapitrisa na mihoatra.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Mora azo kokoa ny soratra noho ny teny, ihany koa. Izany dia marina indrindra ho an’ny adiresy, izay matetika sarotra tononina mazava.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Maro ireo firenena no mahafehy tanteraka ny teny Anglisy, ary any amin’ny maro noho ireny dia azonao ampoizina ny hahita fahalalana voafetra – indrindra eny amin’ny tanora.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Alaivo sary an-tsaina, raha mety ianao, olona iray avy ao Manchester, Boston, Jamaika sy Sydney miray latabatra miaraka misakafo hariva ao amina trano fisakafoanana any Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Mifampirevy amin’ny alalan’ny tantara avy amin’ny tananany izy ireo, tantarainy amin’ny fitenin-dry zareo any.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Ny fiividianana sakafo any amin’ny tranom-barotra lehibe no mora hatrany raha te ho voky. Amin’ny tsy fananana fahafahana ny ahandro dia lasa voafetra ny safidy amin’ny sakafo efa vonona ny hohanina.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Mihamahazo vahana ny fananan’ny toerampivarotana lehibe sakafo tonga dia vonona maro azo isafidianana. Ny sasany aza dia mampiasa ireny lafaoro micro-onde ireny na koa fomba hafa mba hamanana ny sakafo.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Amin’ny firenena sasany na karazana fivarotana sasany dia misy farafahakeliny toeram-pisakafoana iray eo an-toerana, matetika dia toeram-pisakafoanana iray tsy manara-penitra amin’ny vidiny mirary.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Manaova sy mitondrà dika mitovy amin’ny taratasim-piantohana sy ny mombamomba ny mpiantoka ianao.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Ilain’izy ireo aseho ny adiresy mailakan’ny mpiantoka sy ny laharana findray iraisam-pirenena mba hahafahany mangataka torohevitra/fahazoan-dalana ary manao fitarainana.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Asio dikamitovy iray anatin’ny entanao ary iray ao amin’ny aterineto (alefaso mailaka amin’ny tenanao, na ao amin’ny “habaka fitahirizana”).
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Raha toa manao dia miaraka amin’ny solosaina fentina mandehandeha na tablette dia asio dika iray ihany anatin’ny tahiriny na ny kapilany (izay hita foana na tsy misy aterineto aza).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Omeo dika mitovy amin’ny politika sy ny serasera ihany koa ny mpiara-mitsangatsangana sy ny havana na namana miverina an-tanindrazana izay vonona hanampy anao.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Ny élan (fantatra ihany koa hoe wapiti) dia tsy tena hoe masiaka, fa raha mahatsapa fandrahonana izy dia hiaro ny tenany.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Rehefa tsy hitan’ny olona hoe mampidi-doza ny serfa, dia mety hanakaiky be loatra ka hampidi-doza ny tenany.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Sotroy am-pifehezana ny zava-pisotro misy alkôla.Samy hafa ny fiantraikan’ny alkôla amin’ny tsirairay, ary tena zava-dehibe ny mahafantatra ny fetranao.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Ny fisotroana zava-pisotro mahamamo dia mety hitarika olana ara-pahasalamana maharitra, toy ny aretin’ny voa sy fahajambana ary fahafatesana. Mitombo izany loza izany rehefa misotro zava-pisotro mahamamo tsy ara-dalàna.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Ny laodivy tsy ara-dalàna dia mety misy loto samihafa mampidi-doza, tahaka ny methanol, izay mety hiteraka fahajambana na fahafatesana, na dia fatra kely aza.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Mety ho mora kokoa ny solomaso any amin’ny firenena vahiny, indrindra any amin’ny firenena kely fidiram-bola izay mora kokoa ny karaman’ny mpiasa.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Eritrereto ny fanaovana fitiliana maso ao an-trano, indrindra raha tafiditra anatin’ny fiantohana izany, sy ny fitondrana ny taratasim-panafody mba hametrahana azy any amin’ny toerana hafa.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Roa ny olana mety hahazo ireo Marika avo lenta any amin’ireny toerana ireny : ny sasany amin’ireny misy hosoka, ary ireo tena izy dia lafo noho ny any an-tanàna.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Ny kafe dia anisan’ireo zavatra ifanakalozana be indrindra manerana izao tontolo izao ary mety mahita karazany maro ianao amin’ny toerana iavianao.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Na izany na tsy izany, misy fomba be dia be fisotroana kafe eto ambonin’ny tany izay tsara andramana daholo.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Ny canyoning (na : canyoneering) dia ny fandehanana any amin’ny faran’ny hadilalana, izay na maina na feno rano.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Tafiditra anatin'ny canyoning ny lomano, fihanihana sy fitsambikinana -- nefa tsy dia ilàna fiofanana firy na toe-batana matanjaka vao azo atomboka (raha oharina amin’ny fihanihana vato, fisitrihana ambany ranomasina na ny fanaovana ski an-tendrombohitra, ohatra).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Ny dia an-tongotra lavitra dia hetsika fanao ivelan’ny trano izay handehandehanana any amin’ny tontolo natoraly, matetika eny amin’ny làlana voatokana hanaovana dia an-tongotra lavitra.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Ny tsangatsangana indray andro dia manisy halavirana latsaky ny mile miakatra hatramin’ny halavirana lava kokoa izay azo atao anatin’ny andro iray.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Raha hanao dia an-tongotra lavitra mandritra ny iray andro amina lalana mora aleha, dia mila fiomanana kely, ary izay olona antonony rehetra dia afaka mankafy tsara izany.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Mety hila fiomanana bebe kokoa ny fianakaviana misy zaza bitika, saingy mora atao ihany ny mivoaka iray andro na miaraka amin’ny zaza mena vava sy garabola aza.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Maneran-tany, misy eo amin'ny 200 eo ireo fikambanana mpikarakara fizahantany misy hazakazaka. Mahaleo tena ny ankamaroan’izy ireo.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Ilay mpandimby ny Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours dia mifandray amina mpanolotra fitsangantsanganana an'hazakazaka roa ambinifolo eo amina kaontinanta efatra.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Niantomboka tamin’ny Running Tours Barcelona ao Barcelona sy ny Running Copenhagen ao Copenhagen, nanatevin-daharana azy haingana ny Running Tours Prague ao Prague sy ny hafa.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Betsaka ny zavatra mila heverina sy dinihina aloha sy mandritran’ny fanatontosana dia.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Rehefa manao dia ianao, miomàna fa tsy hitovy amin'ny "any an-tanàna" ny zava-misy. Ny fomba, lalàna, sakafo, fifamoivoizana, trano, fenitra, fiteny, sy ny sisa dia tsy maintsy misy lafiny maha-samy hafa azy amin’izay nipetrahanao.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Ity dia zavatra tokony tazoninao ao an-tsaina lalandava, ny miala ny fahadisoam-panantenana na koa ny tsy fitiavana ny fomba fanaovan-javatra any an -toerana.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Efa teo ny masoivoho mpikarakara fivahinianana hatramin’ny taonjato faha 19. Ny mpikarakara fivahinianana dia safidy tsara ho ana dia mihoatra ny zavatra efa niainan’ny mpivahiny teo aloha mahakasika ny natiora, kolontsaina, fiteny na firenena kely fidiram-bola.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Na dia vonona ny handray ny ankamaroan’ny famandrihana tsotra aza ny masoivoho maro, betsaka ireo birao izay mifantoka amina karazana dia manokana, karazana teti-bola na fivantanana.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Metimety kokoa ny manatona masoivoho izay efa zatra mamandrika dia mitovy amin’ny anao.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Asio maso ireo fitsangatsanganana misy fihenam-bidy, na eo amin’ny tranonkala izany na eo amin’ny fitaratry ny fivarotana.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Raha te ahita izao tontolo izao amin’ny fomba mora ianao, noho ny filàna, fomba fiaina na fanamby, dia misy fomba vitsivitsy ahafahana manao izany.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Amin’ny ankapobeny dia mizara ho sokajy roa ireo : na sady miasa no mandeha na sady miezaka mametra ny fandanianao. Ity lahatsoratra ity dia mifantoka amin’ity farany.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Ho an’ireo izay vonona hanao sorona ny fahazoana aina, ny fotoana ary ny fahafantarana mialoha mba hahafahana manena ny fandaniana hanakaiky ny aotra, dia jereo ny tetibola kely indrindra fanaovana dia.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Ny torohevitra dia miainga amin’ny hevitra fa ny mpandeha dia tsy mangalatra, tsy miditra an-tsokosoko amina toerana iray, tsy mandray anjara amina tsena tsy ara-dalàna, tsy mangataka ary tsy manararaotra olona ho an’ny tombontsoany manokana.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Ny toerana fanamarinana mpifindramonina no matetika ijanonana voalohany rehefa hiala fiaramanidina, sambo, na fitaterana hafa.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Any amin'ny sisin-tany sasany dia atao ny fizahana ny fiaran-dalamby an-dalam-pandehanana ary mila fanamarinana manan-kery ny maha-anao anao ianao rehefa miditra amin’ny iray amin’ireny fiaran-dalamby ireny.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Ambonin'ny fiarandalamby misy fatoriana amin'ny alina dia afaka angonin'ny mpanamory ny pasipaoro mba tsy ho tapatapaka ny torimasonao.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Ny fisoratana anarana dia fepetra fanampiny amin’ny fikarakarana fahazoandalana . Any amin’ny firenena sasany, tsy maintsy soratanao eny anivon’ny tompon’andraikitra eny an-toerana ny fisianao sy ny adiresy ipetrahanao.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Mety mila famenoana taratasy avy any amin’ny polisy eo an-toerana ity na mila fandehanana any amin’ny biraon’ny fifindramonina.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Any amin’ny firenena maro izay misy lalàna toy izany, ny trano fandraisam-bahiny ao an-toerana no hikarakara ny fisoratana anarana (aza hadino ny manontany).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Amin'ny tranga hafa, ireo olona izay mipetraka ivelan’ireo fiantranoan’ny mpizahatany ihany no mila misoratra anarana. Na izany aza dia mahatonga ny lalàna ho vao mainka tsy mazava izany, noho izany mila fantarina mialoha.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Ny maritrano dia mikasika ny endrika famolavolana sy ny fananganana tranobe. Matetika mahasarika mpizahatany amin’ny heriny manokana ny maritranon’ny toerana iray.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Betsaka ireo trano izay tena mahafinaritra ny mijery azy ary ny fitazànana avy eo amin’ny trano avo na avy eo amina varavarankely tsara toerana dia tena kanto.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Ny maritrano dia mifanindry be amin’ny sehatra hafa tahaka ny fandrafetana tanan-dehibe, ny injenierian’ny asa sivily, ny fandravahana, ny haiendrika anatiny sy ny fanendrehana zaridaina.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.
