text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: Ny metroRail dia manana sokajy roa amin’ireo lamasinina ao Cape Town sy ny manodidina azy: MetroPlus (antsoina hoe sokajy voalohany) ary ny Metro (antsoina hoe sokajy fahatelo).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: Ny MetroPlus dia ahazoana aina kokoa sy vitsy olona saingy lafo kokoa, kanefa mora nohon’ny tapakila metro mahazatra ao Eropa.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Samy misy MetroPlus sy Mampiofana mitondra Metro ny fiaran-dalamby rehetra; any amin’ny faran’ny fiantsonan’ny fiaran-dalamby foana no misy ny Mpampiofana mitondra MetroPlus, any akaikin’i Cape Town.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Mitondra ho an’ny hafa - Aza atao lavitra anao ny entanao, indrindra rehefa miampita sisin-tany iraisam-pirenena.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Mety misy mampiasa ho mpitatitra zavamahadomelina ianao na dia tsy fantatrao aza, ka hitarika olana be dia be ho anao izany.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Ao anatin’izany dia mila milahatra, satria ireo alika mpioroka rongony dia azo ampiasaina amin’ny fotoana rehetra izay tsy tsikaritra.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Ny firenena sasany dia manana sazy tena henjana na dia voalohany nanaovana heloka aza ; mety ho tafiditra anatin'izany ny fandehanana an-tranomaizina mihoatra ny 10 taona na ny fanamelohana ho faty.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Lasibatry ny halatra ny kitapo tsy voambina ary mety hisarika ny sain’ny manampahefana miahiahy fandrahonana amin’ny baomba.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Ao an-trano, noho ny fisian’ny otrik’aretina ao an-toerana, dia ambony ny taha hoe efa voaaro amin’izy ireny ianao.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Fa any amin’ny toerana hafa eto an-tany, izay vaovao aminao ny tontolon’ny bakteria, dia ho lavitra ny olana kokoa ianao.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Fanampin’izany, any amin’ny toetrandro mafana kokoa, dia sady mitombo haingana kokoa no miaina ela kokoa ivelan’ny vatana ny bakteria.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Izany no nahatonga ny kapoky ny Delhi Belly, ny Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, sy ireo namany be dia be.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Tahaka ny olana ara-pisefoana amin’ny tany mangatsiaka, ny olan’ny kibo amin’ny tany mafana dia miseho matetika ary ny ankamaroan’ny tranga dia manelingelina fa tsy tena mampidi-doza.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Raha voalohany ianao no mandeha any amin’ny tany andalam-pandrosoana - na any amin’ny toerana vaovao eto ambonin’ny tany - dia aza tsinontsinoavina ny mety hisian'ny fifandonana ara-kolontsaina.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Maro amin’ny mpitsangatsangana milamina, manana traikefa no efa resin’ny ny fandrosoan’ny fitsangatsanganana amin’ny tontolo andalam-pandrosoana, izay ahitana fanamboarana kolontsaina vitsivitsy mifanampinampy aingana eo.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Indrindra amin’ny fiantombohan’ny andronao, miezaha manao hadalana kely any amin’ny hotely, ny sakafo sy serivisy amin’ny fomba tandrefana dia hanampy anao ho zatra.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Aza matory amina kidoro na ondana eo amin’ny tany amin’ny faritra iray raha mbola tsy fantatrao ny biby misy eo an-toerana.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Raha handeha hilasy ianao, dia mitondrà fandriana fentina milasy na fandriana mihantona mba hiarovana anao amin’ny bibilava, maingoka sy ny toy izany.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Fenoy kafe marihitra ny tranonao amin’ny maraina ary dite camomille mampiala sasatra amin’ny alina.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Rehefa mijanona ianao dia manana fotoana ikarakarana ny tenanao ary akana minitra vitsy isotroana zavatra miavaka.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Raha mahatsapa ianao fa te hanandra-javatra dia araraoty ny fotoana ahafahana manao ranom-boankazo na smoothies.
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: mety ahita zava-pisotro tsotra be afaka amboarinao ho sakafo maraina ianao rehefa miverina amin’ny rotoroto andavanandro.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Raha mipetraka ami’ny tanàna manana kolontsaina misotro karazan-javatra maro samihafa ianao, dia mandehana any amin’ny bara na toeram-pisotroana tsy falehanao.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Ho an’ireo izay tsy zatra ny voambolana ara-pitsaboana, ny teny mifindra sy miparitaka dia manana dika samy hafa.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Ny areti-mifindra dia aretina iray avy amina sela mitondra ny aretina toy ny tsimokaretina, bakteria, holatra na katsentsitra hafa.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Ny areti-mifindra dia aretina izay mora mifindra amin’ny fanakekezana olona mitondra ny otrikaretina.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Maro ny governemanta  mitaky amin’ireo mpitsidika miditra na ny mponina ao aminy  izay mivoaka ny taniny mba hanao vaksiny amin’ny karazana aretina.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Miankina amin’ny toerana efa nalehany sy ny tany mbola kasainy haleha ny zavatra angatahina amin’ny mpanao dia lavitra.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Anisan’ny herin’i Charlotte, any Carolina Avaratra, ny fananany safidy maro tsara kalitao ho an'ny fianakaviana.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Ny mponina avy amin’ny faritra hafa matetika milaza fa ny fifandraisana toy ny mpianakavy sy ny fahaizana mandray vahiny no antony voalohany nifindrany tany, ary matetika ny mpitsidika dia mahita fa mora mahatamana ilay tanàna rehefa misy ankizy.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Tao anatin’ny 20 taona lasa dia nitombo be ny isan’ireo safidy mety amin’ny ankizy tao Uptown Charlotte.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Tsy mampiasa fiara karetsaka amin’ny ankapobeny ny fianakaviana any Charlotte, azo ampiasaina ihany anefa izy ireo amin’ny tranga sasany.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Efa maveatra ilay izy raha mitondra mpandeha mihoatra ny 2, mety ho lafo kokoa àry ity safidy ity.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Ny Antarktika no toerana mangatsiaka indrindra eto ambonin’ny tany ary mameno ny Tendron-tany atsimo rehetra izy.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Ny fitsidihan’ny mpizaha tany dia lafo, mitaky toe-batana matanjaka, amin’ny fotoana fahavaratra Nov-Feb, ary voafetra ho eo amin’ny Saikanosy, Nosy sy ny Ranomasina Ross.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: An'arivony ny mpiasa mipetraka eto rehefa fahavaratra, anatina trano efapolo eo, ao amin’ireo faritra ireo ny ankamaroany; misy vitsivitsy mijanona mandritra ny ririnina.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Inland Antartica dia lembalemba lao rakotra ranomandry mirefy 2-3 km.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Indraindray ny spesialistan’ny fitsangatsanganana an-habakabaka milatsaka an-tanety, mba handehanana an-tendrombohitra na nahakatra ny tendrony izay manana fototra mivelatra.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: Ny South Pole Traverse (na Highway) dia lalan-tongotra mirefy 1.600 km avy eo amin’ny fiantsonana McMurdo ambonin'ny ranomasina Ross ka hatrany amin’ny Tendrontany.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Orampanala matevina misy hantsana voatampina sy voamarika amin’ny saina kely izany. Ny fiara lehibe voatokana ihany no afaka mandeha eny aminy, mitatitra solika sy vatsy amin’ny korisa.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Tsy dia tena kinga ireny, hany ka tsy maintsy miolaka be manodidina ireo Tendrombohitra Transantarctiques ny lalana vao tonga eo amin’ilay lembalemba.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Ny antony amin’ny ankapobeny mahatonga ny loza amin’ny andro ririna dia ny lalana, lalana (sisin-dalana) ary indrindra ny tohatra malama.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Farafahakeliny, mila kiraro mifanaraka tsara ny faladihany ianao. Ny kiraron-dririnina dia malama be amin’ny gilasy sy ny oram-panala, na ny baotin-dririnina aza dia tsy dia mety.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Tokony ho lalina tsara ny sarisary, 5 mm (1/5 inch) na mihoatra, ary ny akora kosa tokony halefaka tsara anatin’ny maripana mangatsiaka.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Ny baoty sasany dia misy haingony mampiraikitra ary misy fitaovana fanampiny misy haingony mampiraikitra natao ho an’ny toerana malama, izay mety amin’ny ankamaroan’ny kiraro sy baoty, ho an’ny vodikiraro na ny vodikiraro sy ny faladian-kiraro.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Tokony ambany sy mivelatra ny ombelan-tongony. Matetika dia aparitaka eny amin’ny lalana ny fasika na ny vato kely na ny sira (chlorure de calcium) mba hanamorana ny vahana.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Tsy mahagaga ny riakan’orampanala; misy fetrany ihany ny orampanala voatanan’ny hantsana mideza, ary ny habetsahany mihoatra dia hilatsaka toy ny riaka.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Ny olana dia miraikidraikitra ny ranomandry, ka mila tairina mba hilatsaka, ary ny sasany amin’ny ranomandry izay milatsaka no mety hanaitra ny ambiny.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Indraindray, ny seho mitranga voalohany dia ny masoandro izay manafana ny ranomandry, indraindray dia ranomandry milatsaka, indraindray seho ara-boajanahary hafa, fa matetika dia ny olombelona.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Ny tadio dia tsanganan-drivotra ambany tsindry mihodinkodina, izay misintona ny rivotra manodidina mankany anatiny sy mankany ambony.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Mahatonga rivotra be izy ireo (matetika 100-200 miles/ora) ary afaka manainga zavatra mavesatra, mitondra azy tahaka ny fanaon’ny tadio.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Manomboka toy ny lantonoara izy ireo rehefa midina avy amin’ny rahona mitondra tafio-drivotra, ary lasa “tadio” rehefa mahakasika ny tany.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Fomba tena tsara ahafahana mihodidina ny sivana ara-politika sy ny fisivanan-toeran’ny IP ara-barotra ireo mpamatsy VPN manokana (Tambajotra Virtoaly Mitokana).
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Maromaro ny antony mahatonga azy ireo ho tsara mihoatra ny proxy web: Avaoziny daholo ny lalan’ny tambajotra an-tranokala rehetra fa tsy http fotsiny ihany.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Manolotra fifandraisana sy kalitaon-tolotra tsaratsara kokoa izy ireo raha ny mahazatra. Miafina izy ireo ka sarotra tsikilovina.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Ireo orinasa fampahalalam-baovao dia mandainga foana momba ny anton’izao, milaza fa natao ho “fiarovana amin’ny fanaovana hosoka” izy io.
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Ny tena marina, ireo kaody toerana dia tsy misy fiantraikany mihitsy amin’ny fakana dika mitovy tsy manara-dalàna; ny fandikana ny kapila iray dia afaka andefasana azy tsara amin’ny fitaovana rehetra izay mety amin’ny orizinaly koa.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Ny tanjona dia ny hanome ireo orinasa ireo fifehezana bebe kokoa ny tsenany, izany rehetra izany dia mahakasika ny vola miodina.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Satria mandeha amin’ny Aterineto ny antso, tsy mila mampiasa orinasa mpanome tolotra an-tariby eny amin’ny toerana ipetrahanao na ivahiniananao ianao.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Tsy ilaina koa ny maka nomerao ao amin’ilay toerana misy anao; afaka mahazo aterineto amin’ny zanabolana ianao ao amin’ny alan’i Chicken any Alasaka, ary misafidy nomerao izay mody mampiseho fa any Arizaona be masoandro ianao.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Indraindray, mila mividy laharana mitokana ianao hamelana ny PSTN hiantso anap. Misy fahasamihafana amin’ny olona miantso anao ny fihavian’ny laharanao.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Programa mandika teny eo no ho eo - Programa izay afaka mandika teny na fehezanteny avy amin’ny fiteny iray ho amin’ny fiteny iray hafa.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Ny sasany amin’ny fampiasa anatin’ity sokajy ity dia afaka mandika ireo lahatsoratra lavabe amin’ny teny vahiny hita eny amin’ny marika sy zavatra tena misy rehefa atodikin’ny mpampiasa any amin’ireo zavatra ireo ny smartphone.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Efa nihatsara be izao ireo fitaovana fandikan-teny, ary amin’izao dia matetika efa dikateny metimety ihany no omeny (mahalana sisa ny hanomezany teny tsy misy dikany), saingy mila manamboamboatra ihany nefa na izany aza satria mbola mety handiso ny dikateny ihany izy ireny.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Anisan’ny lehibe indrindra amin’ireo rindrambaiko anatin'ity sokajy ity ny Google Translate, izay afaka anaovana fandikanteny na tsy misy aterineto aza rehefa nampidirina ny angondrakitra momba ilay teny ilaina.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Ny fampiasana GPS amin’ny findainao angamba no fomba tsotra sady tsara indrindra andehanana any amin’ny toerana iray tsy firenenao.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Tsy mandany vola kokoa io nohon’ny hoe hividy sarin-tany vaovao ho an’ny GPS na fitaovana misy GPS na hanofa fiara avy amin’ny orinasa mampanofa an’ireny.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Raha tsy manana aterineto amin’ny findainao ianao, na ivelan’ny faritra voakasika, dia mety ho voafetra ny fiasany na tsy azo ampiasaina izy.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Ny magazay rehetra eo an-toerana dia feno karazana karatra finday misy fahana mialoha mampikorontana, izay azo ampiasaina eny amin’ny telefaonina ho an’ny daholobe na telefaonina tsotra.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Raha toa ka ny karatra rehetra dia tsara hiantsoana n’aiza n’aiza, misy ny karatra sasany izay manome tolotra amin’ny antso izay mahasoa any amin’ireo firenena sasany.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Ny fahazahoana ireo serivisy ireo matetika dia avy amin’ny fiantsoana nomerao telefonina tsy andoavam-bola izay azo antsoina amin’ny ankamaroan’ny telefonina.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Ny fitsipika mahakasika ny fakàna sary mahazatra dia natao ihany koa ho an’ny firaketana lahatsary, ary mety ho mihoatra kokoa aza.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Raha tsy azo atao ny maka sary zavatra, dia aza mieritreritra ny haka horonantsary an’io akory.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Raha mampiasa drone, jereo tsara mialoha hoe inona no azonao alaina sary ary fahazoandàlana fanampiny inona no ilaina.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Tsy mety ny mampanidina drône akaiky ny seranam-piaramanidinana ambonin’ny olona maro, na dia tsy voararan’ny lalàna izany amin’ny toerana misy anao.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Ankehitriny dia mahalana ihany ny sidina nofandrihana mivantana tamin'ny alalan'ny zotram-pitaterana an'habakabaka nefa tsy nanaovana fikarohana mialoha sy fampitahana vidy.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Indraindray ny sidina iray dia mety hanana vidiny samy hafa be any amin’ireo masoivoho isan-karazany mpamory tolotra ary andoavam-bola ny fampitahana ny valim-pikarohana sy ny fijerena ny tranonkalan’ilay orinasam-pitaterana an'habakabaka mialohan’ny hamandrihana.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Ny fitsidihana fohy dia tsy ilàna visa any amin’ny firenena sasany raha toa ka hanao fizahantany na handalo noho ny asa, raha amin'ny maha-mpianatra iraisam-pirenena kosa dia mila mijanona elaela amin’ny ankapobeny fa tsy mandalo tahaka ny mpizahatany tsotra.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Matetika dia mila visa mialoha ianao raha te hijanona any amin’ny firenena vahiny mandritra ny fotoana lavalava.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Ny visa ho an’ny mpianatra amin’ny ankapobeny dia mitaky zavatra na fomba fangatahana samy hafa amin’ny visa ho an’ny mpizahatany tsotra na visa fanaovana fandraharahana.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Any amin’ny ankamaroan’ny firenena dia mila manana taratasim-panolorana avy amin’ilay sekoly tianao ianarana ianao, ary manana porofo fa manana vola ampy ivelomanao mandritra ny taona voalohany ianaranao fara-fahakeliny.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Jereo ao amin’ny sampandraharaha sy ny departemantan'ny fifindramonin'ny firenena izay tianao hianarana ny pitsony amin’ireo fepetra takiana.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Raha tsy hoe diplaomaty ianao, ny fiasana any ivelany dia midika matetika fa any amin’ny firenena iasanao no mandoa hetra amin’ny karama ianao.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Ny hetra amin’ny fidirambola dia voarafitra amin’ny fomba samy hafa arakaraka ny firenena ka ny tahany sy ny fizarany dia tena tsy mitovy arakaraka ny firenena.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Any amin’ny firenena federaly sasany, tahaka an’i Etazonia sy Canada, ny hetra amin’ny vola miditra dia alaina eny amin’ny ambaratonga federaly sy eny ifotony, ka miovaova arak’izany ny taha sy ny fetra ambany sy ambony arakaraky ny faritra.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Raha toa ka tsy misy matetika, na fomba fotsiny ihany, ny fanaraha-mason’ny fifindramonina rehefa tonga any an-tanindrazanao ianao, ny fisavana eny amin'ny fadintseranana kosa dia mety hanahirana.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Fantaro izay zavatra azonao sy tsy azonao entina ary ambarao izay rehetra mihoatra ny fetra ara-dalàna.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Ny fomba mora indrindra anombohanao ny asa fanoratana lahatsoratra momba ny fitsangatsanganana dia ny fampitomboanao traikefa amina tranonkala fanoratana bilaogy momba ny fitsangatsanganana efa mitsangana tsara.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Rehefa mahazo aina tsara ianao mamafa sy manaparitaka zavatra ao amin’ny aterineto, dia mety hamorona ny tranonkalanao manokana ianao ao aoriana.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Ny firotsahana an-tsitrapo mandritra ny fanatanterahana dia iray dia fomba lehibe ahafahana manova zavatra kanefa tsy hoe fanomezana fotsiny izany.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Ny fiainana sy ny filatsahana an-tsitrapo any amin’ny firenena vahiny dia fomba tsara iray hahafantarana kolontsaina hafa, hihaonana amin'olona vaovao, hianarana ny momba anao, hahazoana fijery sy traikefa vaovao mihitsy aza.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Mety ho fomba iray hahafahana manalalaka ny toebola koa izany hahafahana mijanona ela kokoa amin’ny toerana iray satria ny asa an-tsitrapo dia manome trano sy sakafo ary misy vitsivitsy manome karama kely.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Nampiasain’ny Vikings hahatongavana tany amin’ny Ranomasina Mainty sy ny Ranomasina Kaspiana ireo lalan-drano rosiana. Mbola azo ampiasaina ny ampahany amin’ireny lalana ireny. Hamarino mety hilana fahazoan-dalana manokana, izay mety ho sarotra ny hahazoana azy.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Ny lakandranon’ny ranomasina fotsy-baltika dia mampifandray ny ranomasimbe Arktika sy ny ranomasina baltika, ary mandalo ny farihy Onega sy ny farihy Ladoga ary i St Petersburg, indrindra amin'ny alalan'ny renirano sy farihy.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Mifandray amin’ny Volga ihany koa ny farihy Onega, ka mbola azo atao ny mandeha avy ao amin’ny ranomasina Kaspiana mandalo an’i Rosia.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Matokisa fa vao tonga eo amin’ny seranana ianao dia hazava tsara daholo ny rehetra. Hifanena amin’ny mpandeha an-tsambo hafa ianao ary hizara an’izay fantany aminao izy.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Raha tsorina dia hanamboatra filazana manambara ny fanampiana atolotrao ianao, hitety ny seranana, hanatona olona manadio ny sambony, hiezaka hifandray amin’ireo tantsambo ao amin’ny bara, sns.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Miezaha miresaka amin’olona maro araka izay azo atao. Afaka kelikely dia hahafantatra anao daholo ny olona rehetra ary hanome sopapa anao momba izay sambo mitady olona.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Tokony mitandrina tsara ianao izay misafidy ny sidina fandehananao.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Na dia eritreretinao fa mandeha ho azy aza ny fandraisana ny zotram-pitaterana an'habakabaka fandehananao indrindra, dia tokony ho tonga saina ianao fa matetika dia samy hafa ny tombony omena ary ny isa azon’ny mpandeha matetika amin'ny sidina dia mety ho betsaka kokoa any amin’ny sidina hafa samy ao anatin'ny firaisana iray ihany.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Ny orinasam-pitaterana ana habakabaka toy ny Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines dia nampitombo be ny tolotra tany Afrika, ary manolotra fifandraisana amin’ny tanàna Afrikana lehibe amin’ny vidiny mirary raha ampitahaina amin’ny an’ny orinasam-pitaterana Eropeana.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Nandeha tamin’ny toerana 39 tao amin’ny firenena afrikana 30 ny Turkish Airlines nanomboka tamin’ny 2014.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Raha manana fotoana fitsangantsanganana fanampiny ianao, jereo ny tontalin’ny tomban’ny saran-dianao any Afrika raha oharina amin’ny maneran-tany.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Aza adino ny manampy ny saran’ny visa fanampiny, ny hetra eny am-piaingana, ny fitaterana an-tanety, sns. ho an’ireo toerana rehetra ivelan’i Afrika ireo.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Raha te hitety izao tontolo izao any amin’ny ila bolantany atsimo ianao, dia voafetra ny fisafidianana ireo sidina sy toerana aleha satria tsy ampy ireo làlana mamaky ranomasina.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Tsy misy fikambanana anabakabaka mandrakotra ireo làlana oseanika telo any amin’ny ila bolantany atsimo (ary ny SkyTeam dia tsy mandrakotra na dia ny iray amin’ireo làlana aza).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Na izany aza, ny Star Alliance dia miantoka ny rehetra afa-tsy ny Pasifika atsimo atsinanana avy eo Santiago-n’i Silia mankany Tahiti, izay sidin'ny LATAM Oneworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Tsy ity sidina ity ihany no azonao safidiana raha tsy te hiampita ny Pasifika Atsimo sy ny sisintany andrefan’i Amerika Atsimo ianao. (jereo eto ambany)
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Tamin’ny 1994, ny faritr’i Azerbaijan, Nagorno-Karabakh, Armeniana ara-poko, dia nitarika ady tamin’ny Azeris.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Niaraka tamin’ny fanohanan’ny Armeniana dia nisy repoblika vaovao niforona. Kanefa, tsy misy firenena mitsangana – na dia Armenia aza – manaiky azy amin’ny fomba ofisialy.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Mbola mitohy manembatsembana ny fifandraisan’i Armenia sy Azerbaijan ny firesahana diplomatika momban’ny faritra.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Ny Distrikan’ny Lakandrano (Holandey: Grachtengordel) dia ilay distrika malazan’ny taonjato faha 17 manodidina ny Binnenstad any Amsterdam.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Ny distrikta manontolo dia natokan’i UNESCO Lova Iraisam-pirenena noho ny kolontsainy sy ny tantarany miavaka, sy ny lanjan’ny toerany izay anisan’ny ambony indrindra eo amin’ny firenena.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinq Terre, izay midika hoe Tany Dimy, dia fitambaran’ny tanàna kely dimy any amoron-tsirak’i Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza ary Monterosson any amin’ny faritr’i Liguria any Italia.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Voatanisa ao amin’ny lisitry ny vakoka manerantanin’ny UNESCO izy ireo.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Tanatin’ny taonjato maro, nanorina lavarangana tsikelikely ny olona, nanorina tanàna teo amin’ny hantsana ka tsy ahitana ranomasina.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Anisan’ny hatsarany ny tsy fisian’ny fivoaran’ny orinasa hita. Lalana,lamasinina ary sambo no mampifandray ireo tanana, ary ny fiara dia tsy afaka tonga any raha avy aty ivelany.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Ireo karazana teny frantsay ampiasaina ao Belzika sy Soisa dia samy hafa kely amin’ny teny frantsay resahana any Frantsa, na dia mitovitovy ihany aza izany ka mifankahazo.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Indrindraindrindra, ny fomba fanisana amin’ny Belga sy Soisy miteny Frantsay dia manana ny mampiavaka azy manokana izay maha samihafa azy amin’ny teny Frantsay izay fiteny any Frantsa ary ny fanonona ny teny sasany dia samihafa.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Na izany aza, ireo Belza sy Soisa miteny frantsay dia nianatra ny frantsay iraisana tany am-pianarana, ka afaka mahazo izay lazainao na dia mampiasa ny fomba fanisa frantsay iraisana aza ianao.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Amin’ny toerana maro eran-tany, ny fikopahan-tànana dia fihetsika tsara, midika fiarahabana.
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Any Malezia kosa anefa, fara-fahakeliny any anivon'ireo Maley any amin’ny faritra ambanivohitra, dia midika hoe “mankanesa atỳ” ilay izy, mitovy amin’ny fanondro miforitra mankany amin’ny vatana, fihetsika fampiasan’ny firenena tandrefana sasany, ary izay ihany no tokony hampiasana azy.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Toy izany koa, ny Anglisy iray mpandeha any Espaina dia mety hihevitra ny kopa-tanana fanaovam-beloma mampiasa ny felan-tanana manatrika ny mpikopaka tanana (fa tsy ilay olona kopakopahina) ho fihetsika fiantsoana hiverina.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Ireo fiteny fanampiny dia fiteny aritifisialy na namboarina sy noforonina mba hanamorana ny fifandraisan’ny mponina izay sahirana amin’ny fifandraisana raha tsy nisy izany.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Izy ireo dia misaraka amin’ny lingua francas, izay fiteny voajanahary na organika ary lasa mahazo vahana noho ny antony maro samihafa noho izy fomba fifandraisana eo amin’ny olona samy hafa fiteny.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Rehefa mafana be iny ny andro dia afaka mahita fahitana mitaratra ny mpandeha, izay mampiseho toy ny endrika rano (na zavatra hafa ihany koa).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Mety hampidi-doza izany raha manenjika ilay taratra fahitana ilay mpandeha, mandany ny hery izay sarobidy sy ny rano sisa tavela.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Na ny mafana indrindra amin’ireo efitra aza dia mety ho lasa faran’izay mangatsiaka amin’ny alina. Tena zava-doza ny hypôtermia raha tsy manao akanjo mafana.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Rehefa fahavaratra, indrindra, dia mila mitandrina amin’ny moka ianao raha tapa-kevitra ny hihanika ny ala.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Na mandeha fiara aza ianao mankanyanaty ala tropikaly atsimo, segondra vitsy mandritra ny hidiranao anaty fiara dia efa ampy hidiran’ireo moka miaraka aminao ao anaty fiara koa.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Ny gripa mpahazo ny vorona, na ny marimarina kokoa gripam-borona, dia mety hahavoa ny vorona sy ny biby mampinono.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Latsaky ny arivo ny tranga izany tsy mbola notaterina tamin’ny olombelona, kanefa maro amin’izy ireo no mahafaty.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Ny ankamaroan’ireo dia nahakasika olona izay miasa miaraka amin’ny fiompiana akoho amam-borona, kanefa misy loza mitatao ihany koa ho an’ireo mpandinika vorona.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Ireo fjords mideza sy ireo lohasaha izay manome tampoka aminà lembalemba somary marina ihany no mampiavaka an’i Norvège.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Ireny lembalemba ireny matetika dia antsoina hoe “vidde” izay midika hoe toerana midadasika, tsy misy hazo, faritra tsy misy fetra.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Ao Rogaland sy Agder izy ireo dia antsoina hoe: “hei” izay midika oe toerana feno fotaka tsy misy hazo fa matetika rakotra anjavidy.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Tsy tafitombona ny vongan-dranomandry, fa midina manaraka ny tendrombohitra. Izany dia hiteraka fitresahana, hantsana, ary mety ho hamaizinin’ny tetezan-dranomandry.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Mety hirodana ireo rindrina sy tafon’ny zohin-dranomandry ary mety hikatona ny triatra.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Eny amoron’ireny vongandranomandry be ireny dia misy bolongana goavana miendaka ka mianjera ary mety hitsambikina na hikodiadia lavitra kokoa miala ny morony.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Ny vanim-potoanan’ny fizahan-tany eny antendrombohitra no mahazo vahana indrindra amin’ny vanim-potoana fahavaratra any Indiana.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Kanefa, hafa ny hamevany sy hakantony rehefa amin’ny andro ririnina, misy fiantsonana betsaka eny an-tendrombohitra, izay mahazo fanala tsara mpanao ski na snowboard.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Orinasam-pitaterana an’habakabaka vitsy sisa no mbola manolotra saran-dalam-pisaonana, izay mampihena kely ny vidin’ny dia amin’ny fandevenana amin’ny minitra farany.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Ny sidina manolotra izany dia ny Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa ho an’ny sidina miainga avy any Etazonia na Canada, sy WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Amin’ny tranga rehetra dia tsy maintsy mamandrika amin’ny finday mivantana any amin’ny orinasam-pitaterana an’habakabaka ianao.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
